그 주 주말에 열리는 길르앗 졸업식을 청중 없이 진행하기로 결정했습니다.
다음 문제는 세계 본부를 봉쇄할 것인지 결정하는 것이었습니다.
베델 인근 회중들에 감염자가 발생했다는 보고가 들어왔죠.
베델 성원들이 회중 활동을 위해 나가야 하는 상황이었습니다.
모든 중앙장로회 성원에게 연락해서 상황을 설명했습니다.
우리는 만장일치로 베델을 즉시 봉쇄하기로 결정을 내렸습니다.
한 시간 내로 본부 성원 전체에게 베델 안에 머무르고
만약 밖에 있다면 즉시 베델로 돌아오라는 메시지가 전달되었습니다.
얼마 후에 우리는 패터슨에 몇몇 감염 사례가 있다는 걸 알게 되었습니다.
베델 가족 전체에게 전염병이 퍼질 수도 있었던 것이죠.
우리는 여호와의 보호의 손길을 분명히 느꼈습니다.
기념식 초대장 배부 활동도 시작될 예정이었습니다.
집집을 방문해서 초대장을 전하는 것이 안전할지,
왕국회관에서 모일 수 없다면 어떻게 해야 할지
바이러스가 여러 나라로 퍼지기 시작했기 때문에
공개 봉사 활동을 중단할 필요가 있다는 것이 분명해졌습니다.
계속 집집을 방문하는 것은 생명의 신성함에 대한 존중심이나
이웃에 대한 사랑을 나타내지 않는 것이라는 점을 깨닫게 되었습니다.
그래서 편지 증거와 전화 증거 방식으로 전파 활동을 하기 시작했습니다.
전화 증거와 편지 증거에 빠르게 적응하는 것을 보면서 많이 놀랐습니다.
전파 활동이 줄어드는 것이 아니라 오히려 늘어나는 모습을 볼 수 있었죠.
집회 참석은 어떻게 할지도 결정해야 했습니다.
‘미리 녹화된 집회를 그냥 JW 스트림에서 시청하면 되지 않을까?’
서로 대화도 나누고 “격려를 주고받을” 수 있는 도구를 사용하면
우리는 몇몇 지부에서 이미 줌을 사용해 회중 집회를 보고 있다는 것을 알았고
‘세계 전역에서 이 도구를 사용해 집회를 보는 것도 가능할까?’
이미 사용하고 있는 지부에 문의해 보았습니다.
중앙장로회는 전 세계에서 집회 때 줌을 사용하도록 승인했습니다.
회중들이 품위 있는 줌 집회를 볼 수 있도록 신속히 도왔습니다.
일주일 안에 기술 및 신권 지침이 모든 회중들에 전달되었습니다.
얼마 안 있어, 수많은 줌 계정을 구매한 다음
재해 구호 마련의 일환으로 많은 회중에 공급했습니다.
하지만 인터넷 문제로 줌을 사용할 수 없는 전도인들도 있었죠.
기념식 초대장 배부 활동이 시작되기 전에 중앙장로회는
이러한 상황에 어떻게 대처해야 할지 모든 지부들에 지침을 전달했습니다.
또 기념식 연설은 jw.org에 게시하도록 했다는 점도 알려 주었죠.
한 지부에서는 텔레비전과 라디오 방송을 사용하면 어떨지 문의했습니다.
‘좋은 아이디어인데, 한번 해 보자’ 하는 생각이 들었죠.
기념식이 있기 겨우 이틀 전에 아프리카의 모든 지부 구역에서
텔레비전과 라디오 방송을 사용하기로 승인이 났습니다.
아프리카의 많은 형제 자매들이 정말 놀라고 기뻤을 겁니다.
기념식 방송이 시작하기 직전에야 전국의 모든 형제 자매들이
다 같이 모이지 않고 기념식을 갖는 것은 우리 모두에게 정말 새로운 일이었죠.
여호와께서 이 마련을 축복해 주셨다는 걸 분명히 볼 수 있었습니다.
조정자 위원회 사무실의 기존 업무들도 팬데믹 기간에 계속해 나가야 했습니다.
북방 왕이 형제들을 박해하는 문제도 계속 대처해야 했고,
재해나 그 밖의 많은 문제들도 처리해야 했습니다.
팬데믹이 한창이던 2020 봉사 연도 중에 있었습니다.
우리가 마지막 날에 살고 있다는 분명한 증거를 매일 볼 수 있었죠.
지부들이 급하고 꼭 필요한 구호 활동은 계속 진행하면서
어떤 것들은 연기할 수 있는지 정할 수 있게 지침을 만들어야 했습니다.
팬데믹 때문에 재해 구호 활동이 훨씬 복잡해진 건 사실입니다.
그러한 어려움에도 중앙장로회가 형제들을 돌보는 일을 멈추지 않는 걸 보고
그러한 재해들로 피해를 입은 것에 더해 일부 나라의 우리 형제들은
매일 필요한 음식을 충분히 구할 수 없었습니다.
정부의 제한 조치, 식품 공급 문제 또는 여러 상황으로
형제들이 일을 할 수 없었기 때문이었죠.
문자 그대로 지부들이 “일용할 양식”을 공급해 주어야 했습니다.
지부들에게 현지 형제들의 필요를 돌보기 위해
상황이 더 나빠질 만약의 경우를 대비해서
가족별로 식품을 비축해 둘 수도 있다는 점도 알려 주었죠.
코로나 바이러스는 왕국 회관에서 열리는 집회뿐 아니라
순회 대회, 지역 대회, 특별 지역 대회까지 영향을 미쳤습니다.
청중이 모이는 지역 대회와 특별 지역 대회를 모두 취소했습니다.
전 세계 형제 자매들이 프로그램을 즐겼습니다.
3월의 그 같은 주에 중앙장로회는 JW 방송에
코로나 바이러스 발생 현황에 관한 동영상을 게시하는 것을 승인했습니다.
그래서 길르앗 졸업식이 있던 그 주말에 인터뷰와 대본을 준비해서
바로 다음 주에 프로그램을 녹화하고 게시했습니다.
중앙장로회 보고는 중요한 역할을 해 왔는데
팬데믹 기간에 전 세계 형제 자매들에게 양치는 방문을 하는 것과 같죠.
백신 공급이 시작되면서 또 다른 어려움이 있었습니다.
백신 접종을 원하는 미국 베델 가족을 위해 백신을 구하기가 쉽지 않았죠.
그래서 2021년 4월 초에 다양한 부서 사람들을 모아 회의를 가졌습니다.
그리고 그들 한 사람 한 사람에게 임무를 주었죠.
백신을 맞기로 선택한 모든 베델 가족에게 접종할 수 있는
한 주쯤 뒤에 모든 지부에 연락해
특별 전 시간 종들이 맞을 백신을 구할 수 있는지 알아보도록 권했습니다.
우리는 아직 백신을 접종하기 힘든 나라에 사는 특별 전 시간 종들을
백신 접종을 원하는 특별 전 시간 종들을 위한 백신을 구할 수 있다고
반면에 연락을 받고 백신을 구하는 것이 불가능해 보인다고 말한 지부들도 있었죠.
그러자 바로 그날 또는 그 다음날
여호와께서 길을 열어 주셨고 백신이 갑자기 생겼습니다.
짧은 시간 내에 그처럼 많은 조정을 하는 것이 쉽지 않았지만
우리는 중앙장로회의 결정 위에 여호와의 손길이 함께하는 걸 볼 수 있었죠.
텔레비전, 라디오, 화상 회의 프로그램이 형제들에게 큰 도움이 되었습니다.
이것은 팬데믹 초기부터 중앙장로회가 내린 결정을
우리는 충실한 종이 베푸는 지침들을 늘 소중히 여겨 왔지만,
그 독특한 시기에 여호와께서 그들을 사용해
중요한 결정을 내리시는 것을 보면서 큰 격려를 받았습니다.
3월의 그 주에 중요한 많은 결정이 내려졌죠.
펜데믹 기간에 어려운 일들이 많았고 슬픈 일도 있었지만,
우리는 많은 긍정적인 일들을 보면서 크게 놀랐습니다.
많은 무활동자들이 돌아왔고 많은 성서 연구가 시작되었습니다.
우리는 여호와께서 각각의 결정들을 하나하나 어떻게 인도해 주시는지를 보았습니다.
또 여호와께서 상황을 헤쳐 나가게 도와주시는 것을 보면서
앞으로 어떤 일이 닥쳐도 똑같이 도와주실 것이라는 확신이 강해졌습니다.
우린 문제가 많은 때에 살고 있습니다.
하지만 여호와의 품 안에 있는데 걱정할 게 없죠.
이번 일을 겪으면서 중앙장로회 성원 각자의 믿음도 강해졌습니다.
정말 우리의 믿음은 계속해서 강해지고 있습니다.
앞으로 신세계에서 누릴 참생명을 위해 우리를 준비시켜 주고 계십니다.
우리는 팬데믹 기간에 여호와의 성령이 작용하는 걸 보았습니다.
그분은 중앙장로회가 생명에 대한 존중심을 나타내면서
성경에 근거한 지침을 베풀고 왕국 활동이 계속되게 하셨습니다.
그걸 보면서 우리의 믿음과 여호와의 조직에 대한 신뢰심이
그런 신뢰심을 지금 기르는 것이 중요한데,
여호와께서 큰 환난을 포함한 앞으로의 일들을 위해
이 기회를 빌어 팬데믹 기간 중에
조정자 위원회 사무실에서 일하는 형제들이 기울인
얼마나 다양한 방법으로 도와주시는지를 경험하는 것은
다음 달 방송에서 시청하실 수 있습니다.
필리핀에 사는 형제 자매들을 만나 보겠습니다.
나라 전체에 걸쳐 놀라울 정도로 다양한 풍경과 지형을 볼 수 있습니다.
아름다운 해변과 푸르른 농경지, 웅장한 산맥을 볼 수 있죠.
전 세계에서 인구 밀도가 가장 높은 도시 중 하나입니다.
이것은 전도인 수의 세 배가 넘는 수입니다.
가장 큰 섬 중 하나인 민다나오가 있습니다.
옥수수, 쌀, 카카오, 포멜로, 두리안이 있습니다.
두리안은 자극적인 냄새로 유명한 아시아의 인기 있는 과일입니다.
회중은 새벽 3:30에 줌 집회를 보기로 했습니다.
더 안정적으로 사용할 수 있기 때문입니다.
집회를 통해 주어지는 영적 양식을 하나도 놓치지 않았습니다.
인터넷도 전화도 전혀 되지 않는 곳들도 있습니다.
그래서 형제들은 라디오 방송을 통해 집회를 듣습니다.
그런 어려움에도 그들의 열심은 전혀 약화되지 않았는데
특히 원주민들에게 좋은 소식을 열심히 전하고 있습니다.
2019년 이후로 마르거스 회중에는 블란어 집단이 생겼습니다.
블란족 사람들은 수공예품과 화려한 전통 의상으로 유명합니다.
현재 블란어로 여러 출판물과 동영상이 나와 있어서
원주민들은 모국어로 진리를 들을 수 있습니다.
마르거스 회중에 속한 블란어 집단의 28명의 형제 자매들이
지금까지 여호와의 증인의 세계 본부에서 JW 방송이었습니다.

en.text: Welcome to the January 2022 edition
of JW Broadcasting®!
The 137th annual meeting
of the Watch Tower Bible and Tract Society
of Pennsylvania
was held on October 2, 2021.
How joyful it was to be together in person
in the Warwick auditorium for this event!
The Bethel family members in attendance
enjoyed a wonderful lineup of spiritual talks,
exciting updates, and videos.
Now we’re delighted to be able to share
the entire program with you here on JW Broadcasting.
The Governing Body assigned me to be the chairman for the annual meeting
and to anchor the January and February JW Broadcasts.
This month, we’ll see the first part of the program,
and Part 2 will be featured in next month’s broadcast.
So please enjoy the first half
of the 2021 annual meeting.
Do you know what time it is?
Most of us are conscious of time every day.
We have a time to go to work, a time to go to school, a time to eat,
a time for our Christian meetings,
and even a time for association
with our dear friends.
As the Great Timekeeper,
Jehovah reminds us at Ecclesiastes 3:1
that there is a proper “time for everything.”
And thus, it’s not surprising that the Bible speaks
of the right time for various events.
For example, at Leviticus 26:4,
Jehovah promised the obedient Israelites
that he would bless them with “showers of rain at [the] proper time.”
Well, that’s just a detail, probably, for most of us.
But if you’ve ever lived in a farming community
or you’ve done farming yourself,
you know that rain at the right time
can give you a bumper crop,
but rain at the wrong time
can completely destroy that same crop.
Even words can be spoken at the right time.
Proverbs 15:23 says:
“A word spoken at the right time
—how good it is!”
Truly, it is a fundamental principle
that timing is everything.
Well, think for a moment about prophesied events
that took place right on time.
Jesus was baptized at precisely the time
when the Messiah was prophesied to appear.
The Kingdom began its heavenly rule
right on time in 1914.
And looking to the future, Jesus said
that Jehovah has set the time,
even the exact day and the hour,
for the end of this wicked system of things.
Does the Governing Body know
when Armageddon is going to come?
Yes, we do.
It’s going to come right on time.
We have full confidence in that —don’t we?—
that Jehovah is going to bring about those earth-shaking events
exactly on time.
But there is something else that Jehovah has promised
to provide at the proper time.
Would you go to your Bibles?
Let’s look at Matthew chapter 24
and verse 45.
Now, here Jesus posed this question:
“Who really is the faithful and discreet slave
“whom his master appointed over his domestics,
“to give them their food
“at the proper time?
“Happy is that slave if his master
“on coming finds him doing so!
“Truly I say to you, he will appoint him
over all his belongings.”
Well, what did Jesus say here?
He said that he would appoint a “faithful and discreet slave”
who would provide the spiritual food.
But there is another important detail there —did you notice it?
He added “at the proper time.”
Well, because of Jehovah’s perfect sense of time,
he knows exactly what his people need
and he knows exactly the right time to provide it.
Now, just consider a couple of examples of this.
Just as World War II was erupting,
the November 1, 1939, issue of The Watchtower
featured an in-depth discussion
of the topic of neutrality.
That timing was absolutely perfect.
Because of those articles,
our brothers worldwide
knew exactly what to do
as the war engulfed the entire planet.
Well, after the war as the organization was rapidly growing,
Jehovah’s organization arranged
large international conventions
that were held in New York City.
In 1958, a quarter of a million people —can you imagine?—
overflowed Yankee Stadium and the Polo Grounds.
Were any of you there?
Well, it’s so wonderful that we still have a few people who were there.
It’s not that I wasn’t in the truth at that time;
it’s just that I wasn’t in the world at that time.
Well, that amazing convention
came just on time.
It energized God’s people and, we could say,
it put Jehovah’s Witnesses on the map.
It was hard to ignore a convention
of a quarter of a million people.
Well, fast forward to 2020
at a time when the world was engulfed
in a global pandemic.
Large gatherings were prohibited in most countries.
Could we go to Yankee Stadium and have
250,000 people there?
No.
But right on time,
Jehovah guided “the faithful and discreet slave”
so that our worldwide brotherhood
could enjoy the convention program from home
—truly, spiritual “food
at the proper time.”
And during the pandemic, we’ve had to change our methods, haven’t we?
We’ve had to receive direction about how to carry out our preaching work
and how to carry out our congregation meetings.
But throughout this period, we have received
powerful, powerful evidence
that Jehovah has given this direction to us at the proper time.
Now, let me just give you a couple of examples.
During the 2021 service year,
at least 22 branches
have reported an all-time peak in the number of publishers.

Are you there?
Is your name there?
Is your name “written in the book of life”?
What “book of life”?

Yes, this “book of remembrance” is a record of all those

some of whom have their names in the book of life and others who don’t.

Those who have been selected to rule with Jesus in heaven.
Are their names written in this book of life?
According to Philippians 4:3,
the answer is yes.
But even though they’ve been anointed with holy spirit,
they still need to remain faithful

The second group:
the great crowd of Armageddon survivors.
Are the names of these faithful ones now written in the book of life?
Yes.
What about after they survive Armageddon?
Will their names still be in the book of life?
Yes.

At Matthew 25:46, Jesus says
that these sheeplike ones depart
“into everlasting life.”
But does that mean they are granted everlasting life
at the beginning of the Thousand Year Reign?
No.
Revelation 7:17 tells us
that Jesus “will guide them to springs of waters of life.”
So they don’t immediately receive everlasting life.
However, their names are written in the book of life
in pencil, as it were.
The third group:
the goats who will be destroyed at Armageddon.
Their names are not in the book of life.
2 Thessalonians 1:9 tells us:
“These very ones will undergo the judicial punishment
of everlasting destruction.”
The same could be said of those
who have deliberately sinned against the holy spirit.
They too receive everlasting destruction,
not everlasting life.
So the first three groups are
the anointed,
the great crowd,
and the goats.
Of these three,
only two are found in the book of life.

Those who will be resurrected
in the new world.

“which hope these men also look forward to,
“that there is going to be a resurrection

These include some of our loved ones.
Are their names written in the book of life?
Yes.
Revelation 17:8 tells us

Jesus referred to Abel as living “from the founding of the world,”
so we can assume that his name
was the first name written in that book.
Since that time, millions of other righteous ones
have had their names added to this book.
Now, here’s an important question:

were their names taken out of the book of life?
No.
They’re still living in Jehovah’s memory.
Remember, Jesus said that Jehovah

The righteous will be restored to life here on earth
with their names still written in the book of life.
They did good things before they died.
So that is why they will be part
of the resurrection of the righteous ones.
No doubt some of them will receive privileges,
such as serving “as princes in all the earth.”

They did not live righteous lives.
So that’s why they are called unrighteous.
When these unrighteous ones are resurrected,
are their names written in the book of life?
No.

Those who have their names written in pencil in the book of life

No.

The resurrection of judgment

No.

Well, now we’re primed

His theme is

We live in a time that will end in final judgment
by means of God’s Kingdom.
Jesus described this time
when he gave his disciples a prophetic sign
regarding his invisible presence
at “the conclusion of the system of things.”
Since his prophecy applies to our day,
we should be very interested in its details.
It also points to a bright future
for those who heed its warnings.
We find the prophecy
in Matthew chapters 24 and 25,
Mark chapter 13,
and Luke chapter 21.
After revealing many of the things
that would occur, Jesus provided warnings
for his disciples by means of three parables.
First, he gave the parable of the virgins,
then the parable of the talents,
and finally the parable
of the sheep and the goats.
The parables show how a person’s behavior
will affect his or her final judgment.
The two parables apply to those
(the first two) with the heavenly hope,
and the third parable applies
to those with an earthly hope.
Yet no matter what our hope may be,
all of us can learn from the warnings
found in Jesus’ parables.
Let’s start with the third parable.
In the parable of the sheep and the goats,
Jesus described the final judgment
for sheeplike ones and goatlike ones
during the great tribulation.
As Jehovah’s appointed Judge and King,
Jesus will be completely righteous
in the judgment that he gives.
As a thorough Judge,
he is already observing the actions, attitudes,
and speech of all people,
including how they treat his anointed brothers.
By the start of the great tribulation,
Jesus will have identified those
who are sheeplike or goatlike in their conduct and attitude.
From that time onward,
those who are goatlike will not seek to change.
However, those who are sheeplike
and who have the hope of living forever on earth
will need to remain faithful in order for Jehovah
to keep their names “in the book of life.”
Then, just before Armageddon,
God’s Son will pass final judgment
on all of those then living here on earth.
Persons who are judged to be righteous
will enter into everlasting life on earth.
What a marvelous reward
for those who keep their integrity!
Although Jesus’ third parable
applies to those who hope to live on the earth,
anointed ones too must listen
to the warning message found in that parable.
How so?
Because Jesus is observing their actions,
attitudes, and speech as well.
They too must prove to be righteous and faithful.
Still, a few questions remain.
For example, how are anointed Christians
undergoing a period of judgment today?
And what warnings did Jesus provide for them?
We find the answers to both questions
in the first two parables of Matthew chapter 25.
To prepare us for this review,
let’s briefly consider how anointed Christians are chosen.
We’ll start by looking at a lesson from ancient times.
When the priesthood was established in ancient Israel,
Jehovah decided who would serve as high priest
as well as the underpriests at the tabernacle.
Exodus 28:1 tells us
that he selected “Aaron, along with his sons.”
No one could rightly question Jehovah’s choice,
and those chosen had to prove worthy of their calling.
Similar to what he did back then,
Jehovah chooses those who will serve as priests in heaven.
He began by selecting Jesus
to serve as High Priest.
Although Jesus was a perfect man,
he did not choose that role for himself.
We read at Hebrews 5:5
that “the Christ did not glorify himself
by becoming a high priest.”
Likewise, those who will serve as priests in heaven
do not choose themselves for this assignment.
They are selected by Jehovah
and anointed with his holy spirit.
He knows each one whom he has anointed for this service.
How do faithful anointed ones view their heavenly calling?
When a person is anointed by God,
he or she knows without a doubt that it is from Jehovah
and that one accepts Jehovah’s choice with gratitude.
Instead of feeling proud or haughty,
anointed ones strive
to imitate Jesus’ example of humility.
They’re helped to do so by keeping in mind
the lessons and warnings
that are found in Jesus’ parables for them.
It’s noteworthy that just before relating his parables,
Jesus spoke about a “faithful and discreet slave”
who would distribute spiritual food
at the proper time during the last days.
That slave pictures a small group
of anointed Christian men today, the Governing Body.
For their faithful service, Jesus said
that there would be a reward, but he also provided a warning.
He spoke about what would happen
if that slave ever lost sight of Jesus’ future return
and started to mistreat his fellow slaves.
If that were to happen,
that slave would be viewed as evil and would,
as Matthew 24:51 states,
be ‘punished with the greatest severity.’
Please note that Jesus was not prophesying
that there would be an evil slave.
This is a warning, not a prophecy.
What was the warning?
That the faithful slave needs to remain watchful.
Yet, it is not just “the faithful and discreet slave”
who must remain watchful.
By means of his parables, Jesus warned
that all anointed ones must likewise prove
to be discreet, faithful, and watchful.
Now, how did Jesus make his point?
In the parable of the virgins, Jesus spoke
of ten virgins who went out to meet a bridegroom.
They hoped to accompany the bridegroom into his marriage feast.
Jesus described five of the virgins
as discreet and five as foolish.
The Greek word used for “discreet”
conveys the idea of understanding,
forethought, discernment, and wisdom
in a practical sense.
So the discreet virgins were wise,
and they showed this by being ready
when the bridegroom arrived in the middle of the night.
They had lamps to light their way.
And Matthew 25:4 adds that “the discreet [virgins]
took oil in their flasks along with their lamps.”
So they had the means to keep their lamps burning.
Because they proved to be ready,
they could follow the bridegroom into his marriage feast.
This action depicts genuine anointed ones
entering into their heavenly reward.
They will be judged as worthy
to join the Bridegroom, Jesus, in his heavenly Kingdom.
But what about the foolish virgins?
Well, unlike the discreet virgins,
the foolish ones were not ready when the bridegroom arrived.
Their lamps died out.
As a result, they could not follow the bridegroom
and enter into his marriage feast.
When they later tried to do so,
they heard the bridegroom tell them:
“I do not know you.”
What is the lesson and warning
that Jesus was illustrating?
He was showing that only anointed Christians
who “keep on the watch” and prove to be ready
will follow him into the reward.
Notice, though, that Jesus did not say
that there would be a large number of foolish ones
who would be unprepared when he comes in this way
at the great tribulation.
Here, too, this is a warning, not a prophecy.
We’re not focused on five of them being discreet
and five of them being foolish.
Jesus was simply letting anointed ones know
what would happen if they failed to “keep on the watch.”
That is a sobering thought.
Whether our hope is heavenly or earthly,
all true Christians should listen to the warning
found in the parable of the virgins.
We must “keep on the watch”
and always be ready
to carry out our service to God.
Now, after using the parable of the virgins
to emphasize the need to be discreet,
Jesus related a parable that highlights the need to be faithful.
It is the parable of the talents, or money.
In this parable, Jesus tells about two slaves
who were faithful to their master
and one slave who was not.
How did the two slaves prove to be faithful?
Well, the faithful slaves worked hard
to increase the money that their master entrusted to their care
just before he traveled abroad.
When he returned, the faithful slaves
had more to give back than what they had received
and they were blessed for doing so.
But what about the third slave, the sluggish one?
What did he do with what he had received?
Well, the sluggish slave buried what he had been given
and failed to increase his master’s talents.
When the master returned, that slave had nothing additional
to give to his master.
He even tried to blame the master,
calling him “a demanding man.”
As a result, that slave did not receive greater blessings.
More than that, what he had been given
was taken away from him,
and he was cast out of the master’s household.
What did the master’s response mean for each of his slaves,
and whom do they picture today?
The two faithful slaves depict anointed Christians
who proved to be valued members of the master’s household.
The Master, Jesus, invites them
to “enter into the joy of [their] master.”
That joy pictures their heavenly reward.
On the other hand, the bad example of the sluggish slave
provides a warning for anointed ones.
How so?
If anointed ones do not remain alert and watchful,
they could become self-satisfied with what they have received.
They might not extend themselves in Kingdom service.
They could lose sight of their responsibilities
and fail to do as 2 Peter 1:10 urges,
where they are told “to make the calling
and choosing sure for themselves.”
If any of them become like the sluggish slave,
they would not be approved to enter into the heavenly Kingdom
and share in the joy of the Master.
Once again,
Jesus was providing a warning, not a prophecy.
Clearly, all anointed Christians
must strive to be both discreet and faithful.
Whether our hope is heavenly or earthly,
all true Christians are determined to remain faithful to Jehovah.
We are secure in our relationship with him.
We’re not concerned if Jehovah
chooses to anoint some faithful ones in more recent years.
We recall what Jesus said regarding the “11th-hour” workers
in his illustration about the vineyard.
You can read about it in Matthew chapter 20.
Those who were invited to work in the vineyard later in the day
received the same reward from the master of the vineyard
as those who were invited to work in it earlier in the day.
Likewise, Jehovah and his Son know how many anointed ones to call
in order to complete the number of 144,000
before the end comes.
But no matter when they are selected,
each anointed one who is judged to be faithful
will receive their heavenly reward.
Now with that in mind, let’s consider
Matthew 24:40, 41.
And as we do, we’ll see how these verses
connect to Jesus’ parables for the anointed.
At Matthew 24:40, it reads:
“Then two men will be in the field;
“one will be taken along and the other abandoned.
“Two women will be grinding at the hand mill;
one will be taken along and the other abandoned.”
Did you notice some similarities to the parables?
Jesus spoke of two men working in a field
and of two women working at a hand mill.
Outwardly, they appear to be the same.
But in each case, Jesus said that “one [would] be taken along
and the other abandoned.”
He then urged his followers to “keep on the watch, therefore,
because you do not know on what day your Lord is coming.”
Jesus said something very similar
after relating the parable of the virgins.
In both examples, he provided a warning.
Since the parable of the virgins applies to anointed Christians,
do Jesus’ comments about those who are taken along
also apply to the anointed?
It appears that they do.
And here again, Jesus was providing a warning.
In his great prophecy regarding “the conclusion of the system of things,”
we find that Jesus lovingly highlights
both the good news of the Kingdom,
as well as warning messages for all people,
including his followers.
Down to this day, our message follows the same pattern.
It is both one of salvation as well as one of warning.
And we must continue to do all that we can
to deliver Jesus’ twofold message
and help others to act on it while there is still time.
Clearly, Jehovah and his Son want us
to remain discreet, faithful, and on the watch.
So, what have we considered?
Some of the virgins in Jesus’ illustration
found out that the door was shut,
and they heard the bridegroom tell them:
“I do not know you.”
One of the slaves in Jesus’ illustration of the talents
did not enter into his master’s joy
but was thrown outside into the darkness.
Jesus also indicated
that not all would be taken along into the heavenly reward.
What a serious warning for those who have the heavenly hope!
Even so, we are confident
that the full number of them will be filled.
Truly, this is a time of judgment for all of God’s people,
including the righteous sheep who yearn to live forever on earth.
But there is no reason for any of us
to fear the final judgment that is yet ahead.
Our loving heavenly Father promises to give us
“power beyond what is normal” so that we may,
as Luke 21:36 says,
“succeed in . . . standing before the Son of man.”
So then, whether our hope is heavenly or earthly,
we must heed the warnings found in Jesus’ parables
and thereby keep our names “written in the book of life.”
We thank you so much, Brother Cook,
for that excellent review of warnings
that we need to keep in our minds.
Well, did you capture all of the fine points
of those three talks?
We’re now going to pass out the exam sheets.
No, just kidding.
But if you would like to review
those talks carefully, and we know you will,
guess what?
They’re going to be presented to the worldwide brotherhood
in the January monthly edition of JW Broadcasting.
So you all will have the opportunity to carefully review your notes
to make sure you got all the fine points in those wonderful, wonderful talks.
Well, the Governing Body has asked that a brief update
about the construction of the Ramapo headquarters facility
be shared with you at this time.
Now, despite the pandemic,
we have clearly seen Jehovah’s hand on the Ramapo project this year,
so please enjoy the following visual update.
Before the main project begins,
contractors have already been assisting to repair and strengthen
an existing stone-faced bridge on the road into the site.
When completed,
the restoration of this structure
will serve as a beautiful feature of the property.
More important,
Jehovah has greatly blessed the efforts to work through the planning process
with the town of Ramapo.
That process is now in the final stages of obtaining
the necessary permits to start the large, new construction project.
In the first quarter of 2022, Jehovah willing,
contractors will start clearing the site
in preparation for earth-moving
and installation of underground utilities
and for readying the locations
where the first buildings will be constructed.
This in itself will take many months,
and we look to Jehovah to bless this key phase that, when concluded,
will open up the project
for many volunteers to come and share in the work.
Much forethought and work has gone into the arrangements needed for feeding,
housing, and providing temporary office spaces
for all such willing brothers and sisters.
The design team is fully engaged in preparing the construction documents.
The drawings for some buildings are well-advanced;
others are in the concept stage.
No doubt, seeing these concept images
of the future Ramapo facility
is exciting and encouraging to all of you.
Well, with all of you, we continue to pray that Jehovah will bless
this very exciting theocratic project.
Throughout the COVID-19 pandemic,
we have felt Jehovah’s loving care
as we’ve received helpful direction
just at the right time.
Please listen and watch
as those who work in the Coordinators’ Committee Office
recount how events unfolded with the pandemic
and how Jehovah has guided matters throughout this time.
In January of 2020,
we started seeing news reports
about a disease outbreak in Wuhan, China.
Now at the time, it seemed localized and was not of global concern.
But a short time later,
the numbers were going up
as the virus began to spread.
Borders were closing, and airports were shutting down.
On January 22, the Coordinators’ Committee
received their first letter from a branch
about the coronavirus.
The letter was from the Korea branch.
Soon after that,
we wrote to all branches in and around Asia
and included guidelines on what to do
if they had an outbreak in their territory.
We had dealt with local epidemics before
but nothing like this on a worldwide scale.
It was clear that the virus was going to affect almost every aspect
of our theocratic operations.
And during those first few months of 2020,
the organization would be faced with a huge amount of decisions.
You have to realize that this was catching us
right in the middle of our activities.
Our schedule for the whole year had already been planned.
We had shepherding visits to branches, regional conventions,
even special conventions.
And now we had Gilead graduation
and Memorial coming up right in front of us.
What were we going to do?
One of the first things
the Governing Body decided
was that the Coordinators’ Committee
would become the central channel
of communication regarding COVID-19.
Meanwhile, the graduation
of the 148th class of Gilead
was in two weeks.
Should we have guests come?
Should there be a live audience?
There was not much time to make these decisions.
However, after prayer and discussion,
the entire Governing Body decided
not to have a live audience
for the Gilead graduation that weekend.
That was unheard of!
The next thing we needed to figure out
was whether to lock down headquarters at Bethel.
I clearly remember it was a Friday night,
March 13.
We were getting reports of COVID cases
in the congregations around Bethel.
And we also knew that the Bethelites
would be going out to their congregation and other activities over the weekend.
If we were going to do something, we needed to do it quickly.
We called each member of the Governing Body
and explained the situation.
And all were unanimous
that we should lock down Bethel immediately.
So within the hour, a message went to the entire headquarters
and United States Bethel family to stay in,
and if you were out, to return to Bethel immediately.
Sometime later,
we learned that there were some COVID cases at Patterson.
If we had moved ahead, potentially we could have spread COVID
through the whole Bethel family!
We really felt Jehovah’s protective hand.
The same weekend as the Gilead graduation,
the Memorial invitation campaign
was scheduled to begin.
And so branches were asking:
Is it safe to go door to door and to distribute invitations?
What if we can’t meet at our Kingdom Halls?
As the virus had spread in many countries,
it became evident
that we needed to suspend the public ministry.
This was a very serious decision.
But when we prayerfully analyzed the situation,
we realized we would not be showing respect
for the sanctity of life or love of neighbor
if we continued house to house.
Our preaching work shifted to letter writing
and telephone witnessing.
And what a huge witness has been given in this way!
It was amazing to me personally when I saw how quickly
the brothers could adapt to using
Zoom, phone witnessing, letter writing.
And instead of it being a huge setback for the work,
it was almost as though the work even moved ahead.
We were also having to deal
with what to do about our Kingdom Halls and our meetings.
Initially, some of the brothers were thinking,
‘Maybe we could just simply watch the prerecorded meetings
on JW Stream ®.’
Well, while that’s an excellent provision,
if we were going to do this for a long time,
it would be wonderful to use a tool
that would allow the brothers and sisters to come together virtually,
to be able to interact and have that “interchange of encouragement.”
We knew that a few branches had already started using Zoom
for congregation meetings,
and we wondered, ‘Could this tool be used
for congregation meetings globally?’
So we asked those branches
for their recommendations
on how we could use this tool further.
We got their comments, we did some testing,
and then the Governing Body approved the global use of Zoom  for meetings.
At the same time, though,
the Coordinators’ Committee urgently wanted
to help those congregations to arrange
dignified Zoom  meetings.
And so within a week, technical and theocratic guidelines
were released to all congregations.
And shortly after that,
tens of thousands of Zoom  licenses were purchased
and then provided to many congregations as part of the disaster relief arrangement.
However, not all publishers could use Zoom  because of lack of Internet.
So in the days leading up to the campaign,
the Governing Body provided direction to all branches
on how to handle those exact situations.
They also announced that the Memorial talk itself
would be made available on jw.org.
So one branch wrote in and asked if they could use
television and radio broadcasting.
And we thought: ‘That’s a good idea.
Let’s try it.’
Once we saw how well it worked in that country,
television and radio were approved
for all branches in Africa
only two days before the Memorial.
How thrilling it was for many friends in Africa
to find out, even moments before the broadcast began,
that they would be able to commemorate the Memorial
simultaneously with their brothers and sisters throughout the country!
To have the Memorial without being able to meet together
was so different for all of us.
Can you imagine that for the 2021 Memorial
there was an all-time peak
Clearly, we have seen Jehovah’s blessing
on these arrangements.
While all these new arrangements
were being made at a rapid pace,
the usual work of the Coordinators’ Committee Office
didn’t stop because of the pandemic.
We still had to deal with the king of the north
persecuting our brothers.
We still had disasters and many other things to contend with.
In fact, we handled twice as many disasters
in the 2020 service year
in the middle of the pandemic
than we did in 2018.
On a daily basis, we saw clear evidence
that we are living in the last days.
We had to come up with guidelines
to help branches determine
what aspects of relief work
could be postponed
and at the same time ensure that urgent or necessary work went ahead safely.
While there’s no doubt that the pandemic
complicated disaster relief efforts considerably,
it was so faith-strengthening to see
that the Governing Body refused
to allow those complications to prevent them from caring for our brothers.
In addition to the impact these disasters had on our brothers,
in some countries our brothers
couldn’t even get enough food for their daily needs.
This could have been because of government restrictions, supply issues,
or other circumstances that wouldn’t allow the brothers to work.
Literally, the branches had to arrange to provide their “daily bread.”
Branches were encouraged to establish disaster relief committees
to care for the needs on a local level.
Reminders were provided to help families
try to prepare a reserve of food, if at all possible,
in case the situation became worse.
Of course, the virus affected not only our meetings at the Kingdom Hall
but also our circuit assemblies,
regional conventions, and special conventions.
So the Governing Body decided to cancel
all live regional and special conventions
That lead to a landmark convention program
on jw.org
that the entire brotherhood enjoyed.
That same week in March,
we approved that a JW Broadcasting® news release
about the coronavirus outbreak
be developed.
So interviews and scripts were prepared
during that Gilead graduation weekend,
and the program was recorded and released
the following week.
The Governing Body updates
have been an important way for us to shepherd
the entire organization during the pandemic.
Well, once vaccinations became more prevalent,
we faced another challenge.
The United States branch was struggling to get vaccines
for those in the Bethel family who wanted them.
So in early April 2021, we called together a meeting.
We had all the key individuals there from the various departments,
and everyone was given an assignment.
And within two weeks, we had enough vaccines
to vaccinate everyone in the U.S. Bethel family
who chose to be vaccinated.
Well, about a week later, we sent a letter to all branches,
encouraging them to investigate the availability of vaccines
for special full-time servants.
We were especially concerned about special full-time servants
serving in lands where the government was not yet making vaccines available.
After that direction went out,
we had a tremendous response from a number of branches
who were able to obtain vaccines for special full-time servants
who wanted to receive them.
Several branches said that it had seemed impossible
to get vaccines in their country at that moment,
but they prayed about it, they followed the direction,
and then either that same day or the very next day
Jehovah opened the doors and suddenly they had the vaccine.
All of these events occurred rapidly,
and even though it was difficult
to make so many adjustments
in such a short period of time,
we could see Jehovah’s hand
in the Governing Body’s decisions.
Television, radio, videoconferencing
have all served our brothers well,
which just goes to show that Jehovah was guiding the Governing Body
as they made these decisions so early in the pandemic.
You know, we’ve always appreciated
the direction we receive from the faithful slave.
But at that unique time especially,
it was so encouraging to see Jehovah use them
to make these major decisions.
And they made many that one week in March.
Although there have been many challenges
and sad times during the pandemic,
it’s been amazing
to see many positive developments.
So many inactive ones have returned.
So many Bible studies have been started.
We saw how Jehovah guided us through
—decision by decision, step-by-step.
And seeing how Jehovah led us through this situation
has helped me to see that regardless of what is going to come up in the future,
Jehovah is going to do the same thing.
Like the Scriptures say, we get our plagues.
We have those times.
But overall, when you’re in Jehovah’s arms,
what’s the worry?
You could say that every one of the Governing Body’s faith
was strengthened as we got through this trial,
and it’s just a continuous thing of our faith being built up.
And how Jehovah is directing us!
And he’s preparing his people
for life in that new world
—the real life that’s coming.
It’s been a real privilege to see Jehovah’s spirit in action
during this pandemic.
It’s strengthened our faith to see him use the Governing Body
to provide Scripturally based direction and keep the Kingdom work going,
all the while showing respect for life.
As a result, our trust in Jehovah’s organization
is stronger than ever before.
And building this trust now is vital
because Jehovah is preparing us for future events,
including the great tribulation.
Well, we take this opportunity to thank
all of the brothers who work in the Coordinators’ Committee Office
for the hard work that they put forward during the pandemic.
It was just amazing to see how many ways
Jehovah has directed matters during these challenging times.
What an encouraging program!
And that was just the first half.
There’s so much more to enjoy.
We’ll see you here next month for the rest of the program.
But before we go,
we’d like to meet our brothers and sisters in the Philippines
in this month’s video postcard.
The Philippines is a tropical country in the western Pacific Ocean
that’s made up of more than 7,100 islands.
Across those islands,
you’ll find an astonishing diversity of landscapes
—from pristine beaches
and lush farmlands
to dramatic mountain ranges.
There are also bustling cities,
including the capital, Manila
—one of the most densely populated cities in the world.
The over 230,000 publishers
living in the Philippines
preach to a population
of more than 109 million people.
attended the Memorial.
That’s more than three times the number of publishers.
Let’s travel to the southern part of the country
to one of the largest islands,
Mindanao.
Here farmers grow staples like corn and rice
along with cacao, pomelo,
and durian —a popular Asian fruit
famous for its unusual, pungent smell.
The southern tip of Mindanao is home
to the 97 publishers in the Margus Congregation.
In this remote part of the country,
the pandemic posed some unique challenges.
Because of unreliable Internet service,
the congregation chose to schedule its meetings on Zoom
at 3:30 a.m.
Why so early?
The Internet signal is more stable
during those early hours of the morning.
The publishers may have missed out on a few hours of sleep,
but they didn’t miss any of the spiritual food
being provided through the meetings.
In other areas served by the congregation,
there’s no Internet or cell service at all,
so the brothers listen to meetings broadcast over radio.
But those challenges haven’t dampened their zeal,
especially when it comes to sharing the good news
with the indigenous population.
Since 2019,
the congregation has been hosting
a B’laan-language group.
B’laan is an indigenous language
spoken by about 125,000 people.
The B’laan people
are famous for their handicrafts
and colorful native costumes.
With several publications and videos
now available in B’laan,
native speakers can hear the truth
in their own language.
The 28 brothers and sisters
of the B’laan group
in the Margus Congregation
would like to send you their warm love and greetings.
And please remember, dear brothers and sisters,
we love you all very much.
From the World Headquarters of Jehovah’s Witnesses,
this is JW Broadcasting!

第137届年会

2021年年会的第一部分

耶稣说

定好了时间

中央长老团知道
哈米吉多顿什么时候来到吗？

哈米吉多顿会准时来到

耶和华上帝会让那些惊天动地的事件
准时发生

来看看马太福音24:45-47

受主人委派管理他的仆役
在适当的时候给他们食物呢？
他的主人来到
看见奴隶正这样做
奴隶就有福了！
我实在告诉你们
主人会委派他管理所有财物。”
那么，耶稣在这里说了什么呢？
他说
他会委派一个“忠信睿智的奴隶”

你留意到了吗？
他说“在适当的时候”
因为耶和华上帝有完美的时间观念
他确切地知道他的子民需要什么
也知道应该在什么时候满足他们的需要
我们来考虑一下这方面的几个例子
就在第二次世界大战刚刚爆发的时候
1939年11月1日出版的守望台杂志
深入探讨了怎样保持政治中立这个问题
那些文章真的非常适时
正是由于那些文章
弟兄们清楚地知道了在这场全球性的战争中
他们应该采取怎样的立场
在战争结束后
随着耶和华的子民迅速发展
组织在纽约市举行了一场大型国际大会
你可以想象吗？
有25万人涌入了洋基体育场和马球场
有人当时在场吗？
哇，太棒了，我们还是有些人参加过
我没参加不是因为我还没认识真理
而是因为我还没来到这个世上呢！
组织适时地安排了这个鼓舞人心的大会
让上帝的子民深受激励
也可以说让全世界认识了耶和华见证人
在当时
一个25万人参加的大会
很难不引起关注
现在，我们来到2020年
这一年，全世界都深受疫情的影响
大多数国家都禁止大型集会
我们可以邀请25万人
去洋基体育场吗？
当然不可以
但就在那个时候
耶和华指引忠信睿智的奴隶
让全世界的弟兄姐妹
可以在家里享受大会的节目
真的是在“适当的时候”
提供滋养信心的食物
同样，在疫情期间
我们不得不调整以前的做法
不论是在传道方面
还是基督徒聚会方面
我们都需要接受新的指引
但就在这段时间
我们也看到了非常有利的证据
证明耶和华在适当的时候为我们指引方向
现在，我想给大家举几个例子
其中一个是
在刚刚过去的2021工作年度
至少有22个分部报告说
他们的传道员人数达到了历史新高
你能想象吗？
在疫情期间！
例如
韩国分部报告说，在2021工作年度
传道员的人数每个月
都能达到新高峰
你能想象吗？这可是在疫情期间！
我们在地区里取得了这么丰盛的成果
我相信你们都很想知道
2021年耶稣牺牲纪念聚会
全球的出席人数
凭着我们伟大的上帝耶和华赐下的分外恩典
我很高兴告诉大家
我们已经达到了历史的最高峰
超过了2100万人
你们想知道确切的数字吗？
那么请不断守望
我们会在今天适当的时候宣布
接下来，在今天的节目中
大家会享受丰富多彩的大餐
包括很多不同类型的滋养信心的食物
相信在节目结束的时候，你们一定会同意
这些节目正是我们在这段时间所需要的
在去年2020年的年会上
中央长老团宣布发行了一个
主持圣经课程的新出版物
题目是
《永远享受美好的生命——互动式圣经课程》
这个新出版物采用了一个全新的方法
与感兴趣的人一起学习圣经
弟兄姐妹觉得这个新的出版物怎么样呢？
更重要的是
我们可以怎样通过这个新的学习方法
打动圣经学生的心呢？
请欣赏下面的短片
我们多么高兴在去年的年会上
收到一本新的出版物
《永远享受美好的生命——互动式圣经课程》
有很多传道员正在使用这个新工具
主持圣经课程，并获得了良好的成果
接下来，我们会听听
全球弟兄姐妹的使用体验

en.text: Every spring
the eastern monarch butterfly begins a migration
that rivals that of some birds and whales.
How does such a delicate insect make such a long trip?
Monarchs are strong, efficient flyers
thanks to their wing shape and the way they flap them.
They may also glide on air currents for an extra boost.
In spring, millions of monarch butterflies
leave central Mexico.
They fly northeast
for several hundred miles,
where they reach
the end of their lifespan.
Amazingly, the end of their life
doesn’t mean the end of the journey.
Before they die, they lay eggs.
The next generation hatches, matures,
and keeps flying north again and again
until up to four generations later
when the great
and great-great grandchildren
of the original monarchs
occupy their summer home
mostly throughout
the northeastern United States.
They perform this multigenerational relay
with no training, no map,
and a brain no larger than the head of a pin.
Amazingly, one thing they do have is
a solar compass.
It tells them what direction to fly
relative to the sun
even when it’s behind clouds.
A clock in their antennae adjusts their heading
as the sun moves across the sky.
Monarchs also have an annual clock
that tells them when to begin their journey
back to Mexico before the weather turns too cold.
But the trip home is not so easy.
They’ll need more than efficient flying
and good navigation to succeed
because this generation
will fly the entire journey back,
stretching over almost 3,000 miles.
The monarchs prepare for their journey
in an unexpected way.
They stop producing eggs temporarily
and instead build muscle and store fat.
They grow larger,
can fly almost ten times as far,
and live up to eight times as long.
They’re a butterfly “super generation.”
Their compass heading flips from north to south.
And off they go.
In about two months,
they arrive back
to their point of origin in Mexico
—a place neither they nor their parents,
grandparents,
nor perhaps even their great-grandparents
have ever seen.
Researchers hope that a better understanding of the monarch butterfly
will help create efficient, long-range, micro-air vehicles.
What do you think?
Did the monarch butterfly’s ability
to migrate long distances evolve?
Or was it designed?

여호와께서는 앞으로도 계속 우리를 돌보시지 않겠습니까?
진리를 떠난 사람들로 인한 마음의 고통이었습니다.
여기 보시면, “내가 자주 말했고 지금도 눈물을 흘리며 말하지만,
그리스도의 형주의 적으로 걷고 있는 사람이 많습니다.”
바울은 자신과 가까운 몇몇 사람이 진리를 떠나서 매우 슬펐습니다.
우리 중에는 가족이나 가까운 친구가 진리를 떠나 제명된 분들이 있죠.
장로들이 내린 결정에 의문을 제기할 수 있습니다.
또는 제명된 사람을 대하는 지침에 따르기가 힘들 수 있죠.
믿음에 큰 시험이 될 수 있습니다.
당연히 친구들, 가족들, 장로들은 그를 돕기 위해 최선을 다합니다.
하지만 그가 제명되어야 할 입장에 놓이게 되면
한 발 물러나서 여호와와 그분의 조직을 신뢰해야 합니다.
가족이 오랜만에 만나 저녁 식사를 하고 있는데
갑자기 삼촌이 가슴을 움켜쥐더니 의식을 잃고 바닥에 쓰러집니다.
심폐 소생술을 하는 사람, 의사를 부르는 사람, 각자 할 수 있는 일을 할 겁니다.
하지만 의사가 도착하면, 가족들은 뒤로 물러나서
훈련받은 의료진의 손에 사랑하는 삼촌을 맡길 것입니다.
내가 직접 돌보겠다고 할 가족이 있을까요?
그랬다가는 삼촌이 죽게 될 수도 있습니다.
잘 되길 바라면서 의사의 손에 맡겨야죠.
또 어떤 때는 환자가 회복하지 못하기도 합니다.
훈련받은 의료진이 돌볼 때 회복할 가능성이 더 높다는 거죠.
사랑하는 사람이 여호와를 떠났을 때도 마찬가지입니다.
처음에 할 수 있는 일을 한 후에
한 발 뒤로 물러나 사랑하는 사람을 의사에게 맡겨야 합니다.
영적으로 도움을 베풀 수 있는 영적 자격을 갖춘 남자들의 손에 말이죠.
삼촌이 치료받는 걸 보는 것 자체가 고통스러운 일인 것과 같습니다.
바울이 너무 고통스러운 나머지 눈물을 흘렸다고 말했죠.
우리는 그곳에서 오실 구원자인 주 예수 그리스도를 간절히 기다리고 있습니다.”
바울이 대처해야 했던 세 번째 어려움은
회중에 발생할 수 있는 분열에 대한 염려였습니다.
“같은 정신과 같은 사랑을 가지고 온전히 연합하여 하나의 생각을 가짐으로
회중에 분열이 생기고 있었고 바울은 그것이 염려가 되었습니다.
이 두 편지는 빌립보 회중에 보낸 편지와 비슷한 시기에 기록되었습니다.
바울은 왜 그렇게 연합에 대해 염려한 것일까요?
당시 형제들 사이에 갈등을 빚는 문제들이 있었기 때문입니다.
모두가 할례를 받아야 한다고 주장하는 사람들도 있었고,
그건 개인적인 결정이라고 하는 사람들도 있었죠.
거짓 선생들은 이 문제를 이용해 바울이 사도 자격이 없다고 주장했습니다.
중앙장로회는 이미 이 문제에 대해 입장을 분명히 했습니다.
여호와와 그분의 대표자들을 신뢰했고 그 결정을 지지했습니다.
네, 오늘날에도 회중에 분열과 갈등을 일으킬 가능성이 있는 문제들이 많이 있습니다.
“그리스도 예수 안에 있던 이러한 정신 태도를 여러분 안에 간직하십시오.”
그는 큰 그림인 그리스도에 초점을 맞추었습니다.
그리스도께서 조직을 인도하고 계시다는 걸 신뢰하십시오.
여호와와 예수께서 인도하는 일을 맡긴 사람들을 신뢰하십시오.
목표와 큰 그림에 계속 초점을 맞추십시오.
사실 생각해 보면 우리는 여호와와 그분의 조직이
우리를 위해 해 준 일에 대해 감사하고 있지 않습니까?
지난 몇 년간 우리가 받은 지침은
여호와께서 자신의 백성과, 조직과, 중앙장로회와, 인도하는 사람들과 함께 계시며
그리스도께서 온전히 통제하고 계시다는 걸 분명히 보여 줍니다.
따라서 우리가 받는 지침을 의심할 필요가 없습니다.
이 어려운 시기를 헤쳐 나가는 데 도움이 되는 훌륭한 조언이 들어 있습니다.
“상을 얻기 위해 목표를 추구하고 있다”고 말했죠.
영원한 생명을 하늘에서 누리든 땅에서 누리든 말이죠.
오늘날에도 우리의 주의를 빼앗는 것들이 많습니다.
그런 문제나 어려움에 초점을 맞추다 보면
낙담하거나 화가 나거나 주의를 뺏기게 될 수 있습니다.
우리 앞에 놓인 목표 즉 큰 그림에 우리의 시선을 고정합시다.
이 조직에 속해 있는 놀라운 특권과
여호와께서 마지막 때에 하고 계신 일에 초점을 맞추십시오.
여호와께서 자신의 백성과 인도하는 사람들을 축복하고 계시며
그리스도가 온전히 통제하고 있다는 부정할 수 없는 사실에 초점을 맞추십시오.
성취되는 성경 예언과 미래의 아름다운 희망에 초점을 맞추십시오.
그렇게 한다면, 언젠가는 목표를 추구할 필요가 없게 될 겁니다.
바울처럼 목표를 이루게 될 것이기 때문입니다.

en.text: So our text for today is
Philippians 3:14,
and here the apostle Paul
assures the Philippian congregation
that he has not lost sight of the goal.
In spite of all the distressing things
that he’s dealing with, he’s keeping his mind on the big picture
—the advancement of the good news and the hope that he has for the future.
Well, how can this help us?
Well, let’s consider three things
that Paul was dealing with during the time
that he was writing his letter to the Philippians
that could have diverted his focus and see what we can learn.
The first thing we’ll consider is discouragement.
Well, why?
Well, Paul, as we know, was under house arrest at the time.
He could not do what he wanted to do for Jehovah.
It’s thought that when Paul wrote his letter to the Philippians,
he had been under house arrest for a year or more.
How discouraging this could have been for Paul!
Also, we remember that during this time the Philippian congregation
had sent Epaphroditus to Paul with a gift from the congregation.
Well, what happened?
Epaphroditus was to go and encourage Paul,
but he ended up getting sick to the point of death and then got depressed.
So now, rather than receiving help,
Paul had to worry about and help Epaphroditus to recover
and then deal with his depression and then eventually send him back home,
all the while dealing with his own situation.
And finally, who knows the emotional ups and downs
that Paul dealt with during his imprisonment?
We can imagine him getting reports of:
‘I think your case is going to get heard soon.
Maybe you can leave soon.’
And then: ‘No, sorry.
‘Nothing is happening.
You’re going to be here for a while.’
Well, can you relate to Paul?
Many of our brothers and sisters are getting
emotionally and physically distressed or fatigued
because of this pandemic.
Some of them feel like they are in house arrest.
There seems to be no end in sight.
Sometimes it’s like we take one step forward and two steps back.
We cannot do the things that we want to do for Jehovah.
Well, what do we learn from Paul?
What did he do?
Let’s look at Philippians 1:12.
Where was his focus?
Philippians 1:12—he says:
“Now I want you to know, brothers,
“that my situation has actually
turned out for the advancement of the good news.”
He focused on advancing the good news—the big picture.
In verse 13, he talks about how his situation
was giving a witness to the prison guards,
how his endurance, in verse 14, was encouraging the congregation.
He was not in the situation he wanted to be in,
but he focused on the positive.
See, we need to do the same —keep our focus on the big picture.
The increases that we hear about and the incredible experiences
that we’re hearing show that Jehovah’s people
are continuing to advance Kingdom interests
even during these difficult times.
Now, we have heard so many encouraging reports that remind us
that Jehovah has been with his people and with his organization
during this last period of time —during this pandemic—
so that his organization not only continued
functioning but flourishing.
Should we lose trust now
that Jehovah will not carry us the rest of the way?
This is a good reminder from Paul.
What else was Paul dealing with?
Well, our second point is that he was dealing with pain of heart
because of those who had left the truth.
Look at chapter 3 and verse 18 —Philippians 3:18.
He says: “For there are many
“—I used to mention them often but now I mention them also with weeping—
who are walking as enemies of the torture stake of the Christ.”
Yes, some who used to be close to Paul had abandoned the truth.
This distressed him.
It made him weep.
Well, can we relate?
Well, yes.
Some among us have very close family members or friends
who have left the truth and are now disfellowshipped, and that’s painful.
Now, when emotions are running high,
it can cause us to question decisions made by the elders
or maybe to struggle with the direction
on how to deal with disfellowshipped ones.
It tests our faith.
You see, when somebody is heading into a wayward way, or course,
we all do what we can to help —the friends, family, the elders, everybody.
But when someone has reached the point when he has to be disfellowshipped,
Jehovah now, in effect, says:
‘I have this now.
Leave this to me.’
And what do we have to do?
We have to back off and trust Jehovah and his organization.
Now, we can illustrate it this way:
You could picture (maybe) having a nice family meal with your family.
And during the evening, suddenly your uncle
grabs his chest and falls over on the floor unconscious.
Well, what happens?
Well, we all jump into action.
Somebody starts doing CPR;
somebody calls the paramedics;
the rest of us try to do what we can.
But what do we do when the paramedics arrive?
We step out of the way,
and we leave our loved one in the hands of those
who’ve been trained to handle medical emergencies.
Now, would we ever think of pulling the paramedics off of our uncle
and insisting that no, we’re going to care for him ourself?
No.
We know that by doing that, we will greatly reduce the chances of him surviving.
See, we leave it to the paramedics,
and we hope for the best.
Now, sometimes the patient recovers.
Sadly, sometimes the patient does not recover.
But, yet, we know that he has a much better chance of recovering
at the hands of the trained paramedics.
And see, the same is true with our loved ones who leave Jehovah.
At first, we try to do what we can,
but then we step back and leave it to the paramedics, if you will
—the spiritually qualified men who are trained to offer
necessary spiritual assistance.
That’s Jehovah’s arrangement.
But it doesn’t mean that it’s easy.
It’s painful; it hurts.
It’s similar to watching those events unfold with your uncle there
—it’s emotional; it hurts.
Well, what do we do to get through it?
Well, the same thing that Paul did.
Look back and notice there in chapter 3 and verse 18.
It says that this distressed him so much that he wept.
But where was his focus?
Look at verse 20:
“But our citizenship exists in the heavens,
and we are eagerly waiting for a savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ.”
Yes, he stayed focused on his hope for the future.
The third thing we’ll discuss that Paul was dealing with is concerns
about potential divisions in the congregation.
Notice what he says, as recorded at Philippians 2:2.
He says: “Make my joy full by being of the same mind and having the same love,
being completely united, having the one thought in mind.”
Unity.
Paul was concerned with divisions cropping up in the congregation.
Unity was the theme of his letter to the Ephesians,
and it was also featured in his letter to the Colossians
—all of which were written around the same time
as the letter to the Philippian congregation.
Why was Paul so concerned about unity?
Well, because highly charged issues were circulating at that time.
One that wouldn’t go away was the issue of circumcision.
Some were insisting that everybody must get circumcised.
Others would say, “No, it’s a personal choice whether you do or not.”
False teachers were using this issue to discredit
Paul’s position as an apostle.
Now, the governing body
had made their position on this subject very clear.
Well, what did Paul do?
Well, he trusted Jehovah and Jehovah’s representatives,
and he supported the decision.
Well, do we see similar situations today?
Yes, there are many highly charged issues that exist
that have the potential of creating divisions in the congregation.
We must never let that happen.
It’s a test of our faith.
Well, what did Paul do?
Well, notice a few verses down in verse 5.
He says: “Keep this mental attitude in you
that was also in Christ Jesus.”
He focused on the Christ—on the big picture.
And see, we need to do the same:
Focus on Jesus;
trust that Christ is leading this organization;
trust those whom Jehovah and Jesus trust to take the lead;
keep our focus on the goal and the big picture.
And when we think about it, we appreciate so much
all that Jehovah and his organization have done for us.
And isn’t it true?
We see clearly how the direction
that we’ve received over the years indicates
that Jehovah is clearly with his people, with his organization,
with the Governing Body (those who are taking the lead),
and that Christ is firmly in control.
Why would we question the direction we’re getting now?
Yes, our scripture text provides very good lessons
to help us navigate troubling and distressing times.
Philippians 3:14: “I am pressing on toward the goal for the prize.”
And we need to have the same attitude whether our prize
is everlasting life in the heavens or here on earth.
And like when Paul wrote to the Philippians,
there are many things that can divert our focus today.
And focusing on these troublesome situations
can cause us to become anxious, bitter,
depressed, angry, or distracted.
So may we follow Paul’s example
and keep our eyes fixed firmly on the big picture
—the goal that is set before us.
May we stay focused on the incredible privilege that we have
to be a part of this organization and what Jehovah is doing in these last days,
on the undeniable evidence that Jehovah is blessing his people
and blessing those who are taking the lead, and that Christ is firmly in control.
Stay focused on the unfolding of Bible prophecy
and our beautiful hope that we have for the future.
And if we do, like Paul,
one day we will not need to ‘press on any longer to the goal’
because we will be living it.

cn.text: 今天我们的主题经文是腓立比书3:14
使徒保罗对腓立比会众的弟兄姐妹说
他一直朝着目标努力奔跑
尽管他遇到很多难题和挑战
但他继续专注于最重要的事
传扬好消息，并注视自己未来的希望
我们能学到什么呢？
保罗在给腓立比会众写信的这段时期
其实正在经历三个考验
而这些事很有可能会使他分心
让我们来分析一下这三件事
首先，我们知道
当他给腓立比会众写这封信的时候
正在被软禁，他没办法为耶和华做得更多
那么，保罗被软禁的这段时间
到底有多长呢？
可能至少1年或者更久
这种情况很可能令他灰心
除此之外，我们还知道
在那段时间，腓立比会众派以巴弗提
把会众的礼物带给保罗
后来发生什么呢？
以巴弗提本来是要去鼓励保罗
但结果他生了重病，差点就死了
也变得很忧郁
所以，保罗不但没有得到帮助
还要反过来帮助以巴弗提恢复身体的健康
还要安慰他，最后把他安全地送回了家
在这期间保罗自己也在经历难题
保罗会不会有时充满希望
有时又灰心绝望呢？
这一点我们不知道
保罗可能从别人那里听说
“你的案件马上就被审理了
你很快就可以恢复自由。”
然后很快又听说
“对不起，没什么进展
你要继续被软禁在这里。”
你们也有相似的经历吗？
疫情期间，很多弟兄姐妹有健康难题
还有些弟兄姐妹感到非常忧虑
觉得身心俱疲
感觉就像是被软禁了起来
疫情好像永远都不会结束
情况有时看起来好了一点
但结果又变得更糟
我们想要为耶和华做的很多事都没办法做
保罗教导我们什么？
他做了什么呢？
请翻开腓立比书1:12
看看他专注的是什么
保罗说
“弟兄们，我想让你们知道
我的遭遇其实促进了好消息的传播。”
他专注于最重要的事，就是宣扬好消息
接着，13节提到
保罗的处境反而让他有机会向狱吏作见证
14节也说，他的坚忍鼓励了弟兄姐妹
保罗也不想有这样的遭遇
但他关注的是自己的遭遇带来的好结果
我们也应该有同样的态度
传道方面数据的不断增长
还有许多感人的经历都表明
上帝的子民正在热心地传讲王国的好消息
就算在艰难的时期也一样
最近，我们听到了很多鼓舞人心的报告
这提醒我们在疫情期间
耶和华一直与他的子民同在
他们信心坚定，不但保持忍耐
而且努力工作
在很多方面得到了他的赐福
这让我们确信，耶和华会继续帮助我们
我们从保罗的经历学到了很好的要点
保罗遇到的第二个考验是什么呢？
他看到有些人离开真理，感到非常痛心
让我们翻开腓立比书3:18
“许多人行事为人
根本就是基督苦刑柱的敌人
我以前常常提到他们
现在又流着眼泪提到他们。”
一些曾经跟保罗很亲密的朋友离开了真理
这让他很难过，痛哭流泪
你们有类似的经历吗？
我们当中有些人的家人和朋友离开了真理
现在已经被开除了
这真的让人感到痛心
如果我们过度伤心
就很可能会质疑长老们作出的决定
或者在开除的事上
不同意来自耶和华组织的指引
这会考验我们的信心
如果你看到身边的朋友
家人、长老或其他人
做了可能会犯错的决定
我们当然会尽量帮助他们
但这个人由于自己的行为和态度被开除了
这时耶和华希望我们要把事情交给他来处理
我们该做什么呢？
要停止帮助这个人
把事情交给耶和华和他的组织
现在我们可以用一个比喻来说明这一点
想象一下，在一个晚上
你正在跟家人一起开心地吃饭
你叔叔突然捂住胸口，摔倒在地，不醒人事
那个时候，大家肯定都会来帮忙
有人做人工呼吸，有人叫救护车
其他人也会尽力帮忙
救护车到了，我们会做什么呢？
我们会站到一边
把我们所爱的人
交给那些专业的医护人员来照顾
在这种情况下
你肯定不会一把推开医护人员
坚持自己去照顾叔叔
因为你知道这样做
会大大降低叔叔生还的几率
我们要把叔叔交给医护人员
希望他能恢复健康
当然有的时候病人能恢复过来
不过，有的时候却不能
但无论如何，我们知道
把病人交在医护人员的手里
一定是最好的选择
自己所爱的人离开上帝时
我们面对的情况也是一样
首先要做自己能做的，然后就不要再插手
把事情交给那些成熟的弟兄们
他们被耶和华委任，受过专业的训练
能帮人恢复跟上帝的关系
这就是耶和华的安排
但这对我们来说并不容易
就像你看到叔叔接受医疗救助时的心情一样
我们看到所爱的人离开耶和华
也会感到很伤心
那么，我们应该怎么做呢？
保罗也经历过类似的事
让我们看一下腓立比书3:18
这里说他非常难过，流下泪来
不过，他注视的是什么呢？
来看20节，经文说
“但我们是天上的公民
我们热切等候来自天上的救主
也就是主耶稣基督。”
保罗把焦点放在未来的希望上
保罗经历的第三个考验是什么呢？
就是他担心在会众里可能会出现分裂
请大家留意保罗在腓立比书2:2说了什么
经文说
“要思想一致，爱心一致，意念一致
完全团结，使我满心喜乐。”
这里，保罗强调团结
因为他担心有些事会引起分裂
保罗写信给腓立比会众
以弗所会众和歌罗西会众
几乎在同样的时间段，他完成了这些书信
而信的主题，强调的都是团结
为什么保罗要强调团结的重要性呢？
因为当时在基督徒之间
有一些非常有争议的事情
其中的一个争议就是人是否要接受割礼
有些人坚持认为，所有人都必须接受割礼
而另一些人认为这是个人的选择
假导师利用这件事情来质疑保罗
说他没有资格做使徒
当时的中央长老团
对是否接受割礼的问题有明确的立场
那保罗的态度呢？
他充分信任耶和华
信任中央长老团，支持他们的决定
今天我们也会遇到类似的事情吗？
当然会有
现在的会众里
也可能存在一些很有争议的事情
这也许会导致会众的分裂
这会考验信心
我们绝不能让这样的事发生
保罗是怎么做的？
让我们看腓立比书2:5
“基督耶稣有怎样的思想态度
你们也要有怎样的思想态度。”
保罗注视的是基督，他着眼于大局
我们也要像他那样定睛注视基督
相信耶稣基督正在带领这个组织
相信那些耶和华和耶稣信任的人
也就是带头的弟兄
我们最重要的目标就是着眼于大局
从这个角度看
我们非常感激耶和华和他的组织
为我们所做的一切，真的非常感谢他们
我们看到
这些年来我们收到的指引都清楚表明
耶和华与他的子民、他的组织
与中央长老团和那些带头的弟兄同在
而基督正在掌控全局
对于收到的指引
我们还有什么可怀疑的呢？
腓立比书3:14的经文帮助我们
可以在艰难的时期明智行事
经文说
“朝着目标努力奔跑
为的是要赢得奖赏。”
我们也要有同样的态度
无论我们永生的奖赏是在天上还是在地上
我们现在跟保罗当时所处的情况一样
也面临很多分心的事
如果我们把注意力集中在这些事情上
就会让自己变得忧虑
痛苦、压抑、气愤或分心
愿我们大家都向保罗学习
着眼于最重要的事
我们要着眼于一项殊荣
也就是
我们能成为上帝组织的一员
也着眼于耶和华在最后的日子正在成就的事
我们要留意
耶和华怎样赐福给他的子民和那些带头的人
也要留意基督正在掌控全局
我们要定睛注视圣经的预言怎样应验
以及未来的美好希望
如果我们这样做，就能跟保罗一样
有一天
我们就不需要朝着永生的目标奔跑了
因为我们已经达到了目标

ko.text: 룻기는 예언자 사무엘이 기록한 것으로 여겨집니다.
모압 여자 룻의 이름을 딴 것입니다.
기근 때문에 가족을 데리고 베들레헴에서 모압 땅으로 갑니다.
과부인 두 여자가 베들레헴에 도착했을 때는
룻은 우연히 보아스의 밭에서 이삭을 줍게 됩니다.
계속 자기 밭에서 이삭을 주우라고 말합니다.
나중에 룻이 자신이 보아스라는 남자의 밭에서 이삭을 주웠다고 말하자
그는 우리를 도로 살 사람 중에 하나란다.”
도로 살 사람 역할을 해 줄 것을 청하라고 말합니다.
그렇게 되면 두 사람이 낳은 아이가
엘리멜렉의 가계를 이을 수 있을 것이었습니다.
보아스는 기꺼이 그 사랑에 찬 행동을 하려고 합니다.
하지만 룻을 도로 살 수 있는
더 가까운 남자 친족이 있다고 말합니다.
“아무개”라고 언급되어 있는 그 남자 친족을 만납니다.
자신이 어떤 역할을 해야 하는지 알게 되자
도로 사는 데 따르는 책임을 받아들입니다.
보아스는 여호와께 순종하는 면에서 훌륭한 본을 남겼습니다.
그는 나오미와 룻을 최대한 돕기 위해
도로 사는 일에 관한 하느님의 율법을
다윗은 이스라엘의 왕이 되었고 메시아의 조상이 되었습니다.
그분을 사랑하고 순종하는 사람들에게 어떤 상을 주시는지 살펴보십시오.
하느님의 왕국의 왕이 나오게 되어 있는 다윗 가계에 대해
어떤 점을 알려 주는지 유의해 보시기 바랍니다.

en.text: An introduction to the book of Ruth.
The prophet Samuel is believed to be the writer of this book.
The book of Ruth was completed
about 1090 B.C.E.
The events related cover a period
early in the time of the Judges.
The book takes its name
from one of its principal characters,
Ruth the Moabitess.
The other main characters
are Naomi and Boaz.
In chapter 1,
a famine moves a man named Elimelech
to take his family from Bethlehem
to the land of Moab.
In Moab, Elimelech dies.
His sons, Mahlon and Chilion,
marry the Moabite women Ruth and Orpah.
Some ten years later,
both sons also die.
Naomi, in deep despair, decides to return to Bethlehem.
She urges her daughters-in-law to go back to their families.
Orpah returns “to her people.”
Ruth, however, sticks loyally to Naomi.
When the two widows arrive at Bethlehem,
the barley harvest has just begun.
In chapter 2,
Ruth, by chance, gleans in a field belonging to Boaz,
who is related to Naomi’s late husband.
Recognizing Ruth’s fine qualities,
Boaz tells her to continue gleaning in his fields.
When Ruth later tells Naomi that she had gleaned
in the fields of a man named Boaz,
Naomi says: “The man is related to us.
He is one of our repurchasers.”
In chapter 3,
Naomi instructs Ruth to ask Boaz to act as repurchaser.
He and Ruth could then raise up offspring for Naomi
in order to carry on the family line of Elimelech.
Boaz is willing to perform this loving deed.
But he tells Ruth that Naomi has a closer male relative
who could repurchase her.
In chapter 4,
Boaz goes to the Bethlehem city gate
where he meets with the other male relative,
who is referred to as “So-and-so.”
When the relative, in the presence of ten city elders,
learns of his obligations,
he declines to help.
Boaz then publicly accepts the responsibilities of repurchaser.
Boaz now marries Ruth,
and they have a son,
whom the “neighbor women” name Obed.
Did you know?
Boaz set a fine example of obedience to Jehovah.
He did all in his power to help Naomi and Ruth
by applying God’s law on repurchase,
taking no shortcuts.
The book concludes:
“Obed became father to Jesse;
and Jesse became father to David,”
who became a king of Israel
and an ancestor of the Messiah.
As you read the book of Ruth,
see how Jehovah turns tragedy into triumph,
observe how he rewards those
who love and obey him,
and note how the book contributes
to the history of David’s family line,
which produced the King of God’s Kingdom.

cn.text: 路得记被认为是由先知撒母耳执笔的
这卷书成书于公元前1090年左右
路得记所记述的事发生在士师时代的早期
这卷书以书中的主角摩押女子路得为名
另外两个主要人物是拿俄米和波阿斯
在第1章
因为以色列闹饥荒
以利米勒带着家人从伯利恒搬到摩押
以利米勒死在摩押
他的儿子玛伦和基连分别娶了摩押女子
路得和俄珥巴
差不多过了10年
拿俄米的两个儿子都去世了
拿俄米十分悲伤
决定返回伯利恒
她让两位儿媳妇回娘家
俄珥巴就回“她同胞那里”
但路得却坚持留在拿俄米身边
当她们两个回到伯利恒的时候
当地刚开始收割大麦
在第2章
路得碰巧在波阿斯的田里捡麦穗
波阿斯是拿俄米亡夫的亲戚
波阿斯非常欣赏路得的美好品格
就继续让她在自己的田里捡麦穗
路得后来告诉拿俄米
她在波阿斯的田里捡麦穗
拿俄米就说
“他是我们的亲戚，是我们的购赎人之一”
在第3章
拿俄米告诉路得去请求波阿斯做购赎人
这样路得和波阿斯就可以生下后代
为拿俄米死去的丈夫以利米勒留名
波阿斯很愿意这样做
但是他告诉路得
拿俄米有一个关系更近的亲戚
他有权先购赎
在第4章，波阿斯来到伯利恒城门口
和那位有权购赎的人见面
并称他为“某某某”
这个人知道购赎带来的责任后
就在10个长老面前拒绝这样做
波阿斯随后说
他会履行购赎的义务
波阿斯后来娶了路得
还生了一个儿子
邻家的妇女给这个孩子取名叫俄备得
你知道吗？
波阿斯在服从耶和华方面
立下了良好的榜样
波阿斯认真履行上帝就购赎方面的法律
他竭尽全力帮助拿俄米和路得
这卷书最后说
“俄备得是耶西的父亲
耶西是大卫的父亲”
大卫是以色列的国王
也是弥赛亚的祖先
当你阅读路得记的时候，请留意
耶和华怎样化悲为喜
以及怎样奖赏那些爱戴和服从他的人
这卷书也帮助我们了解大卫的家系
而弥赛亚就出自这个家系
他就是上帝王国的君王

title: 제프리 W. 잭슨: 이제 여러분이 배운 것을 나누어 주십시오!

ko.text: 제150기 길르앗 학급이 졸업할 때가 되었습니다.
길르앗 학교가 제150기 학급까지 열릴 줄 누가 알았겠습니까?
학생 여러분 중에 ‘과연 내가 졸업할 수 있을까?’
그동안 길르앗 학교 졸업식은 여러 형태로 열렸습니다.
사진을 보시면 제7기 학급을 볼 수 있는데요,
이때는 참석하기 위한 표가 필요 없었다고 합니다.
그래서 원하는 사람은 누구나 올 수 있었죠.
길르앗 학교 건물 바로 앞에서 연설을 하는 모습을 볼 수 있습니다.
이러한 졸업식이 마련된 이유는 1953년이 특별한 해였기 때문입니다.
미국 정부가 길르앗 학교를 법적으로 인정해 주어
외국 학생들도 참석할 수 있게 된 해이기 때문입니다.
졸업생들의 기뻐하는 모습을 항상 볼 수 있죠.
최근에는, 청중이 없는 졸업식도 몇 번 있었습니다.
청중들과 함께하게 되어 정말 기쁘지 않습니까?
지난 여러 달 동안 여러분들은 많은 수업을 받고
이 세상의 학교나 교육을 생각해 보면,
모리스 형제의 말처럼, 온통 그들의 꿈에 관한 교육이죠.
온통 학생들이 꿈꾸는 야망과 성공에 관한 것입니다.
여러분이 중요한 게 아니란 걸 분명히 배우지 않으셨습니까?
그걸 못 배우셨다면 학교에 한 번 더 오셔야 합니다.
우리는 우리 자신이 중요한 것이 아니란 걸 잘 알고 있습니다.
학교를 졸업하는 여러분들은 앞으로 어떻게 해야 합니까?
여러분이 배운 것을 다른 사람들에게 나누어 주어야 합니다.
각자 임지로 가서 작은 길르앗 학교를 열어야 할까요?
다른 사람들에게 여러분이 배운 걸 나누어 준다는 건
여러분이 열심히 일하면서 길르앗에서 배운 것을 실천할 때
다른 사람들은 여러분의 본을 보고 배울 것입니다.
하지만 그 밖에도 유의할 만한 점이 있는데,
여러분이 해야 할 또 다른 일이 무엇인지 알려 줍니다.
많은 증인이 확증한 것들을 충실한 사람들에게 맡기십시오.
이 구절에서 무엇을 알 수 있습니까?
열심히 일함으로 여러분의 본을 통해 가르치는 것에 더해
아마도 개인적으로 여러분이 길르앗에서 배운 원칙과 교훈들을
이 면에서 예수 그리스도를 본받을 수 있죠.
하지만 그 일만 하신 것은 아니었습니다.
바쁜 와중에도 무슨 일을 위해 시간을 내셨는지
그분은 그것이 누구에게도 알려지는 것을 원하지 않으셨다.”
조용하게 그들만의 시간을 가지려고 하셨던 것이죠.
그러니까 예수께서는 바쁘신 와중에도 시간을 내서
그들이 미래에 대비할 수 있게 도와주셨습니다.
성경을 읽어 보면 많은 본들이 나오지만
오늘은 특히 바나바에 대해 생각해 보겠습니다.
바나바는 자신이 배운 것을 어떻게 바울에게 나누어 주었습니까?
바나바와 바울 사이에 어떤 일이 있었는지를 생각해 보면,
다섯 가지 교훈을 배울 수 있습니다.
그 다섯 가지 교훈은 다른 사람을 훈련하고
그들에게 우리가 배운 것을 나누어 주는 데 도움이 될 겁니다.
첫 번째 교훈을 위해 사도행전 9장을 펴 보실까요?
사울이 이미 그리스도인이 되었을 때의 일이죠.
사울이 예루살렘에 도착했을 때 무슨 일이 있었을까요?
그가 제자라는 것을 믿지 않았기 때문이다.”
제자들은 바울을 아주 위험한 사람으로 생각했습니다.
“그러자 바나바가 도우러 와서 그를 사도들에게 데려갔다.”
이 그림에서 볼 수 있듯이 바나바는 사울의 잠재력을 보았습니다.
사울이 여호와의 봉사에 유용하게 쓰일 수 있다고 믿었던 것이죠.
바나바는 자신의 평판이 나빠질 위험을 무릅쓰면서
이 기록을 통해 무엇을 배울 수 있습니까?
다른 사람의 잠재력을 보기 위해 노력하십시오.
여러분이 어떤 사람을 격려하고 지원하고 도와주었는데,
혹시 여러분의 평판이 나빠질까 봐 걱정하지 마십시오.
중요한 건 여러분 자신이 아니라 여호와의 일입니다.
좋은 소식이 이방인의 구역에 전해지고 있었고,
자신에게 도움이 더 필요하다는 걸 깨닫게 되었습니다.
사울이 그리스어를 할 줄 알고 교육을 잘 받았다는 걸 기억했죠.
이방인 구역에서 자신을 도와줄 수 있다는 걸 알았습니다.
약 200킬로미터를 가야 했다는 걸 알 수 있습니다.
고린도 후서에 열거된 바울이 겪은 일들 중 상당수가
파선을 당하고 감옥에 갇히는 일 등등이 나오죠.
바나바는 사울을 찾은 다음 어떻게 해야 했을까요?
사울이 이미 생산적으로 봉사하고 있었기 때문에
“그들은 만 1년 동안 사람들과 함께 회중에 모여
“이제 내가 가르쳐 주겠다”고 한 것이 아니라 함께 일했습니다.
이렇게 함께 일하면서 바울은 필요한 훈련을 받은 것이죠.
네, 바나바는 바울의 잠재력을 본 것에 더해 기꺼이 그를 찾아가서
세 번째 교훈은 사도 13장에서 배울 수 있습니다.
바나바와 바울이 안티오크에서 얼마간 함께 있은 후에,
“그들이 여호와를 섬기며 단식하고 있을 때에 성령이 말했다.
보신 것처럼, 두 사람은 이제 선교 봉사를 나가게 되었습니다.
바나바가 인도하고 사울이 그를 따랐던 것이죠.
그런데 같은 장 13절로 내려가 보면 약간의 변화가 생깁니다.
사울은 그 지역에서 더 널리 사용되는
그 시점부터는 바울이 인도하는 일을 한 것 같습니다.
그에게 가서 조용히 이렇게 말할 수도 있지 않았을까요?
“뭐, 그렇게 중요한 건 아닌데, 잠깐 얘기 좀 할 수 있을까요?
바울 형제의 열심이 대단한 건 인정하죠.
하지만 처음에 인도하기로 임명된 사람은 나였던 것 같은데…”
바나바가 전혀 시기하지 않았다고 알려 주죠.
누군가와 함께 일하면서 그를 훈련할 때 명심하십시오.
그가 여러분을 능가한다 해도 시기하지 마십시오.
사실 우리가 누군가를 돕는 것은 그의 발전을 위해서죠.
우리 자신이 원했던 특권들을 받게 될 수 있습니다.
이제 네 번째 교훈을 갈라디아서에서 찾아보겠습니다.
베드로와 바울과 바나바와 디도는 예루살렘에 와 있었고,
기록을 보면 바나바와 바울이라는 말이 나옵니다.
바나바는 다시 자신이 먼저 언급된 것에 유의했을 수 있는데,
중앙장로회가 바나바의 원래 임명을 기억했기 때문일 수 있죠.
그 밖의 몇몇 사람들은 안티오크로 와 있었습니다.
예루살렘에서 모임이 있은 지 몇 달 후인 그때 무슨 일이 있었죠?
바울이 베드로의 잘못된 행동을 지적하는 일이 있었습니다.
그런 가식적인 행동을 했으며, 그리하여 바나바까지
이 일에서 우리는 무엇을 배울 수 있습니까?
‘바울과 바나바’ 하면 바로 떠오르는 사건이 한 가지 있으시죠?
여러분이 무슨 생각을 하시는지 알 것 같은데요,
안티오크에서의 일이 있고 난 후의 사건입니다.
그러나 바울은 마가가 팜필리아에서 자기들을 떠나
그를 데려가는 것을 좋게 여기지 않았다.
그래서 두 사람은 이 일 때문에 감정이 격해져서 서로 헤어졌다.”
흔히 방금 읽은 이 사건을 떠올리실 겁니다.
왜 이런 일이 일어나게 되었는지 생각해 본 적이 있으십니까?
바울은 요한 마가를 데려가는 것을 좋게 여기지 않았습니다.
마가가 갑자기 떠나 버린 일을 기억했을지 모릅니다.
그 당시에 바울이 눈에 문제가 있었고,
몹시 아팠다는 것을 분명히 알 수 있습니다.
짐을 들어 주고 필요한 일을 다 해 줄
바나바는 바울이 마가를 안 데려가고 싶어 하는 이유를
그가 요한 마가를 데려가기로 한 이유는 무엇입니까?
아니면 바나바가 바울에게서 잠재력을 본 것처럼,
요한 마가에게서도 잠재력을 보았기 때문일 수 있을까요?
이 훌륭한 청년에게 다시 기회를 줘야 한다고 생각했을 수 있죠.
바울이 자신보다 진리에 늦게 들어왔기 때문에,
아직 더 배워야 할 사람으로 여겨서
그가 말하는 것을 선뜻 받아들이기 힘들다고 느꼈던 것일까요?
우리 중 누군가는 그들과 함께 일하게 될 테니까요.
‘우리가 그때 문제를 더 잘 해결할 수 있었을 텐데’
좋은 분위기에서 문제를 해결할 수 있었던 때가 있지 않습니까?
다른 사람의 의견을 존중하고, 과잉 반응을 보이지 마십시오.
계속 평화롭게 일할 수 있도록 차이점을 잘 극복하십시오.
생각해 볼 만한 점이 정말 많지 않습니까?
