title: 마크 샌더슨: 그리스도의 정신 태도를 간직하십시오 (빌립보 2:5, 7)

ko.text: 우리는 부정적인 생각에 잠기기가 쉬운 것 같습니다.
우리가 이전에 할 수 있었던 일들에 관해
연설 임명을 받고 다양한 회중을 방문하여
또 어떤 분들은 지부 대표자로 섬기면서
많은 우리 형제 자매들과 함께했던 일들을 생각할지 모릅니다.
지역 대회나 순회 대회에서 큰 부서들을 조직하면서
여러 해 동안 일했던 것을 생각할지 모릅니다.
파이오니아들은 대도시 특별 공개 증거에 참여하거나
그 밖의 다른 공개 증거 활동에
그리고 베델로 출퇴근한 많은 파이오니아들도 있는데,
어떤 분들은 여러 해 동안 그렇게 해 왔죠.
네, 이 모두는 서로 다른 임명에 관한 이야기지만,
아주 좋아하던 그 모든 임명된 일들을
때로는 이런 의문을 갖게 될지도 모릅니다.
난 여호와께 더 이상 귀중하지 않은 걸까?’
이럴 때 오늘의 성구가 도움이 될 수 있죠.
이러한 정신 태도를 여러분 안에 간직하십시오.
곧 하느님과 동등하게 되려고 생각하지 않으셨습니다.
오히려[여기를 잘 보세요, 오히려] 자신을 비우고
“자신을 비우고 종의 모습을 취”했다는 마지막 표현에
하늘에서 누리셨던 지위를 우리가 상상해 보는 것은
성경에서 그것을 살짝 엿볼 수 있을 것 같은데요.
모든 창조물 가운데 처음 난 분이십니다.
다른 모든 것 곧 보이는 것들과 보이지 않는 것들이,
그에 의해 하늘과 땅에 창조되었기 때문입니다.
그는 다른 모든 것보다 먼저 계시고,
그에 의해 다른 모든 것이 존재하게 되었습니다.”
네, 여호와께서 우주와 그 안에 있는 모든 것을 창조하셨을 때
예수께서는 숙련된 일꾼으로 그분 곁에서 일하셨습니다.
그분 없이 생겨난 것은 하나도 없다.”
정말 그분은 하늘에서 놀라운 역할을 하셨죠!
여호와께서 이 땅에서 하라고 주신 임명을 받아들이셨습니다.
그 임명을 받아들인다는 건 무엇을 의미했을까요?
베델의 출입 통제 상태가 오래되다 보니까
힘없는 태아로 아홉 달을 지내셔야 했습니다.
예수께서 하늘의 지위를 떠나 땅으로 오신 것은
예수께서는 임명에 그런 큰 변화가 생겨서
여호와께서 보시기에 자신의 가치가 떨어졌다고 느끼셨습니까?
내가 언제나 그분에게 기쁨이 되는 일을 하기 때문에,
예수께서는 아버지께서 하라고 시키신 바로 그 일을
자신이 하고 있다는 것을 알고 계셨습니다.
그 일은 하늘에 계실 때 하던 일과 같은 일은 아니었지만,
여전히 그분은 아버지께 기쁨이 되는 일을 하고 계셨습니다.
자신을 결코 버리지 않으실 거라고 확신하셨습니다.
그분은 과거에 하셨던 일에 초점을 맞추지 않고,
현재 맡은 임명을 계속 바쁘게 수행하셨습니다.
형제 자매 여러분, 무엇을 배울 수 있습니까?
전염병 때문에 우리 모두의 상황이 변했고
어떤 분들은 임명에 큰 변화가 있었습니다.
하지만 우리의 주된 목표는 결코 변하지 않았죠.
기쁨이 되는 일을 하려고 계속 노력합니다.
우리는 지금 호별 방문을 못 하고 있습니다.
하지만 우리 모두는 여호와를 사랑하기 때문에,
그분께 기쁨이 되는 일을 할 방법을 찾습니다.
더는 수행할 수 없게 되어 낙심이 됩니까?
그렇다 해도 초점을 돌려 여호와와 형제들을 섬기기 위해
지금 할 수 있는 일을 하는 데 집중한다면
자신이 받은 선물과 재능을 사용하며 바쁘게 지낸다면
회중을 세워 주는 일에서 기쁨을 누리게 될 것입니다.”
미국에 사는 한 자매의 경험을 말씀드리겠습니다.
자매는 봉사를 하면서 편지를 몇 통 보냈는데
한 여자분에게서 답장을 받고 무척 놀랐습니다.
정성 어린 편지를 보내 주셔서 정말 감사합니다.
어머니랑 저는 매일 호별 방문을 하곤 했죠.
생일 축하나 여러 축일들의 재미를 맛본 저는
어른이 돼선 둘도 없는 친구가 되었습니다.
전 절대 그 표준에 따라 살 수 없을 것 같았어요.
어머니의 부탁을 받은 한 자매가 성경책 한 권을 줬어요.
성경 앞쪽엔 이런 글이 쓰여 있었죠.
그렇게 하려면 여호와께 돌아가야 한다는 걸 알지만
매일 밤 저는 여호와께 기도를 드렸습니다.
‘제 생각과 마음을 잘 아시는 여호와 하느님,
어떤 교회나 종교에 속해서 당신을 찬양하고 싶습니다.
무엇이 옳은지 알 수 있게 확실한 무언가를 보여 주세요.’
바로 다음 날인 8월 20일에 우편물을 가지러 갔더니
제가 이제부터 해야 할 일을 할 수 있게 도와주세요.
겁이 나지만 제가 필요한 변화를 할 수 있었으면 좋겠어요.
이것이 바로 편지 한 통의 힘입니다.
“일시 정지” 버튼을 눌러야 했던 것은 사실이죠.
그렇다고 여호와 앞에 우리의 가치가 떨어졌습니까?
그분 앞에 우리의 가치는 전혀 떨어지지 않았고,
예수처럼 우리가 과거에 하던 일에 초점을 맞추지 말고,
하늘에 계신 우리의 훌륭한 아버지 여호와께
바로 지금 우리가 할 수 있는 모든 일을 합시다.

en.text: During this COVID-19 pandemic,
it’s not hard for negative feelings
to begin to form in our minds.
We may begin to think a lot
about things that we were able
to do in the past.
For us at Bethel, maybe it’s thinking about some of the speaking assignments
that we had in various congregations,
being with different brothers and sisters and getting to meet different ones.
Maybe we even think about when we served as Bethel representatives
at circuit assemblies or regional conventions
with large, large crowds of our brothers and sisters.
Elders in the field may think about the work that they did
for many, many years on convention committees
or in organizing large departments,
either at conventions or at assemblies.
Pioneers might be thinking about what they did
during the special metropolitan public witnessing program
or just in public witnessing in general.
And then, there are all of the pioneers
that have commuted to Bethel,
some for many years, to support our work.
Well, all of these involve different assignments,
but there’s one thing that they all have in common.
We all have had to hit the “pause button”
on all of these assignments that we love so much.
Well, sometimes we may begin to ask ourselves,
‘Does the fact that I no longer
‘can do these assignments that I loved so much
‘mean that somehow I’ve lost value,
that I’m not as precious to Jehovah anymore?’
Well, this is where our text can be so helpful to us.
Let’s read it again.
Let’s go in our Bibles to Philippians chapter 2,
and let’s read together verses 5 to 7.
Let’s read all three verses.
It says: “Keep this mental attitude in you
“that was also in Christ Jesus,
“who, although he was existing in God’s form,
“gave no consideration to a seizure,
“namely, that he should be equal to God.
“No, [but now let’s focus on this, No,]
“but he emptied himself
“and took a slave’s form
and became human.”
Well now, it’s just a few words there,
but can you imagine what was involved in that last expression:
“He emptied himself
and took a slave’s form”?
It’s really hard for us even to begin to imagine
the position that Jesus occupied
in the heavens before he came to earth.
Maybe we get a little glimpse of it if we go to our Bibles.
Let’s read together Colossians chapter 1,
and let’s look at verse 15.
Now speaking about Jesus, it says:
“He is the image of the invisible God,
“the firstborn of all creation;
“because by means of him
“all other things were created in the heavens and on the earth,
“the things visible and the things invisible,
“whether they are thrones or lordships or governments or authorities.
“All other things
“have been created through him and for him.
“Also, he is before all other things,
and by means of him all other things were made to exist.”
Well, yes, as the master worker,
Jesus was used by his Father
in the creation of the universe
and all of the things in it.
John 1:3 says:
“All things came into existence through him,
“and apart from him not even one thing
came into existence.”
What an amazing role Jesus played in heaven!
But Jesus was willing to give up that position in heaven
and accept the assignment
that Jehovah had for him here on the earth.
But now, what did accepting that assignment involve?
Now, let’s look at three different things.
We might be finding the lockdown challenging,
especially after seven months.
But consider this:
Jesus had to be in the womb of Mary
as a helpless embryo for nine months.
Can you imagine what a change that was for him?
Let’s consider a second thing:
Jesus had been the Spokesman for Jehovah in heaven,
but now Jesus would have to learn to speak
and be taught by imperfect humans.
Let’s consider a third one:
In heaven, his associates had been faithful,
powerful, heavenly spirit creatures.
But when on earth, who were his associates?
Fishermen, former prostitutes,
just the very common, simple, humble people
whom the Pharisees in John 7:49
called “accursed.”
Well, what do you think?
Was that a major change, for Jesus
to leave his heavenly position and come to the earth?
He truly “emptied himself,”
as Philippians 2:7 says.
But now, here’s the question,
Did Jesus feel that somehow he had lost value with Jehovah
because he had gone through such a huge change
in his assignment and now was a human on earth?
Not for a moment.
But why?
Well, will you open your Bibles?
Let’s read together this thought
in the book of John chapter 8,
and let’s look together here at verse 29.
Jesus said: “And the One who sent me
“is with me;
“he did not abandon me to myself,
because I always do the things pleasing to him.”
Isn’t that a beautiful verse?
You see, Jesus knew that the work that he was doing
was the work his Father had asked him to do.
It was not the same work that he had done when he was in heaven,
but he was still always doing
the things that were pleasing to his Father.
And for that reason, Jesus knew in his heart
that Jehovah God would certainly never abandon him.
He kept busy working hard
in his present assignment, not focusing
on what he had done in the past.
Well now, brothers and sisters, what do we learn from this?
We’ve all had some changes
(some of them even major changes)
in our assignments because of the pandemic.
But our primary goal has never changed.
Just like Jesus, we continually seek to do the things
pleasing to our heavenly Father, Jehovah.
Now, we can’t go from door to door right now.
And we can’t do public witnessing,
and we can’t meet at our Kingdom Halls or Assembly Halls, and so on.
But because we all love Jehovah,
we find ways, even in the midst of this pandemic,
to do things that please him.
Now, The Watchtower made an interesting comment.
The Watchtower  of August 2020,
page 25—here’s what it said:
“Do you get discouraged
“because you currently do not have the same privileges
“of service that you had in the past?
“If so, you will be happier
“if you change your focus and concentrate
“on what you can do right now
“to serve Jehovah and your brothers.
“Stay busy, using your gifts and abilities to help others,
and you will find joy as you build up the congregation.”
Well, that’s what we’re all trying to do.
And Jehovah loves us because we’re trying,
and he blesses our efforts.
Now, take this experience that one sister had in the United States.
She had sent out some letters as a part of her ministry,
and imagine how surprised this dear sister was
to receive a letter from a lady that we’re going to call Mary.
Here’s what this letter said:
“Hello, my name is Mary,
“and I want to thank you for sending me a beautiful letter.
“I was a Jehovah’s Witness between the ages of 9 and 12.
“My mother was a full-time pioneer.
“We would go door to door daily.
“But as young as I was and already having the taste
“of birthdays and holidays, I left my mom to live with my dad.
“My mom pioneered for over 25 years.
“She died in 2007.
“Though at my young age I was not close to her,
“in my adult years, we became best friends.
“To her dying day, she would tell me,
“‘Mary, return to Jehovah.’
“I just never felt I could live up to the standards.
“I didn’t want to be a hypocrite.
“That’s my big issue in not studying.
“You can’t keep one toe in.
“It’s all or nothing.
“After my mom died, at her memorial,
“she had a sister give me a Bible.
“And on the front of the Bible she inscribed:
“‘To Mary, from Mom.
“Return to me in Paradise.’
“I want to see her so bad,
“and I know the only way to do so is to return to Jehovah, but I get scared.
“What if I can’t do it right?
“I don’t want to mess up.
“Every night, I say my prayers to Jehovah as I have done.
“But on August 19, 2020, I said my prayers, but this time I asked Jehovah:
“‘Jehovah, you know how I feel, and you know my heart.
“I want to connect to a church, or a religion, to praise you.’
“I said: ‘Jehovah, you know me.
“It almost has to be a brick to hit me to understand what’s right.’
“On August 20th, the very next day,
“I went to get the mail, and I received your letter.
“I could not believe it.
“I was so shocked that I actually sat down and thought:
“‘Wow! Now what do I do?’
“Jehovah answered; now I need to follow through, and I’m nervous.
“I hope that you can help me take the steps I need to take.
“Again, I’m scared, but I hope that I can make the changes I need to make.
Sincerely, Mary.”
Well, that’s the power of one letter.
It’s true, we’ve had to press that “pause button”
on many of the assignments that we have just loved doing.
But does that mean that we’ve lost value with Jehovah?
Jehovah is still with us.
We have not lost any value with him,
and he is not going to abandon us.
So, what do we need to do?
Like Jesus, let’s not focus on what we used to do,
but instead, let’s do everything we can do right now
to do all the things pleasing
to our wonderful heavenly Father, Jehovah.

cn.text: 在冠状病毒疫情期间
我们的思想很容易开始变得消极
我们可能会想起很多
在过去我们能够做的事情
对于伯特利成员来说
我们可能会想起
以前有机会到不同会众发表演讲
有机会认识很多弟兄姐妹
我们甚至会想起
我们作为分部代表
参加分区大会或区域大会时
跟很多很多亲爱的弟兄姐妹们在一起
会众里的长老可能怀念多年来
在大会委员会里的服务
或组织和管理分区和区域大会
各个部门的工作
先驱们
你可能很想念过去
参与的都市公众场所特别见证
或其他任何形式的公众场所见证
还有很多先驱
多年来也通勤到伯特利工作
支持分部的运作
但无论我们被委派做什么形式的服务
现在都面对一个共同的情况
就是我们不得不按下“暂停键”
尽管我们非常非常喜欢这些工作
当面对这种情况时
我们可能会想
现在不能做这些我喜欢的工作了
我是不是变得没有用了呢？
对耶和华来说，我还有价值吗？
今天的经文可以帮助我们应付这种情况
让我们再看一下腓立比书第2章
一起翻到5-7节
让我们一起读一读这3节经文
这里说
“基督耶稣有怎样的思想态度
你们也要有怎样的思想态度
他本来以上帝的形态存在
却从没有想过要夺取跟上帝同等的地位。”
请留意第7节，这里怎么说
“他放弃了一切，接受了奴隶的形态
成为一个人。”
虽然这里只有短短几句话
但是你能想象，对耶稣来说
“他放弃了一切，接受了奴隶的形态”
牵涉到什么吗？
对于我们来说甚至很难想象
耶稣在来到地上之前
在天上拥有多么高的地位
让我们看一下圣经怎么说
翻到圣经的歌罗西书第1章
从15节开始
关于耶稣在天上的情况，这里说
“这位儿子是人看不见的上帝的形象
在受造的万物中，他是头生子
因为天上的、地上的、看得见的、看不见的
无论是在位的、统治的、执政的、当权的
全都是通过他创造的
其余的万物都是通过他、为了他而创造的
他比其余的万物先存在
其余的万物都是借着他才存在的。”
没错，当耶和华创造宇宙和万物时
耶稣一直在他身边提供协助
是耶和华身边的好工匠
事实上，在约翰福音1:3，经文也说
“一切都是通过他而有的
没有一样不是靠他而有的。”
耶稣在天上的地位有多么重要！
但是他依然肯放弃在天上的地位
接受了耶和华给他的新委派，来到地上
这个新委派会带来什么改变呢？
我们来看看三个不同的方面
首先，“封锁”对耶稣是个挑战
我们经历了七个月的封锁
但你想想看
耶稣必须成为一个胎儿
在马利亚的腹中待上9个月
这对他是多大的挑战
第二，我们再想想
耶稣在天上代表耶和华发言
但是现在他必须学习怎样说话
而且是跟不完美的人类学习
再来看第三个方面
耶稣在天上的时候
他周围都是忠心的、大有能力的灵体
但在地上时的情况呢？
有渔夫，还有先前做妓女的
就是那些非常普通、非常卑微的人
在约翰福音7:49里
法利赛派称他们为“被诅咒的”
你觉得怎么样？
改变是不是很大？
他放弃了天上的地位，来到地上
就像腓立比书2:7说的
耶稣“放弃了一切”
你们觉得怎么样？
耶稣的委派发生了巨大的变化
从天上来到地上成为人
他有没有因此觉得
自己在上帝眼中不再那么有价值呢？
从来没有
为什么这么说呢？
请打开圣经
我们来一起看看约翰福音第8章里的内容
约翰福音8:29
耶稣说
“派我来的那位与我同在
他没有舍弃我，没有让我独自一人
因为我时刻做他喜悦的事。”
经文说得很清楚，对吗？
耶稣清楚知道
他当时在地上做的工作
就是他的天父耶和华要他做的
这个工作跟他以前在天上时做的不一样
但他在地上做的仍然是令他的天父喜悦的事
正因如此，耶稣心里非常明白
耶和华绝不会舍弃他
不会让他独自一人
他一直努力做好眼前在地上的工作
而不是一直留恋过去在天上的服务
亲爱的弟兄姐妹
我们学到什么呢？
在疫情期间
我们很可能经历了工作岗位的改变
有些人的改变甚至很大
但我们的主要目标从来不会改变
就像耶稣一样
我们不断寻找方法做令天父耶和华喜悦的事
我们现在不能挨家挨户地传道
不能作公众场所见证
也不能在王国聚会所一起参加聚会
但因为我们都爱耶和华
所以在疫情期间
我们会努力找到方法做令天父喜悦的事
在2020年8月刊的《守望台》里
有这样一段话
在第25页
段落这样说
“你是不是也因为
离开了以前的岗位
而感到很失望呢？
如果是这样
就要专注于你现在能做的事
继续好好为耶和华和弟兄姐妹服务
要善用你的能力
经常帮助别人，鼓励会众
这样你就会得到真正的快乐。”
我们所有人都要努力这样做
耶和华会因为我们的努力而深爱我们
也会赐福给我们
我们来听听一位姐妹的经历
她来自美国
这位姐妹写信作见证
她寄了好几封信出去
有一天她收到一封信
让她非常惊讶，是一位女士寄给她的
这位女士叫做玛莉
信中写道
“你好，我叫玛莉。
很高兴收到你的信，我非常感动
我9到12岁的时候也是一位耶和华见证人
我妈妈一直是一位正规先驱
那个时候我们每天会挨家挨户地传道
但小时候我很想过生日和其他的节日
后来就离开了妈妈，跟爸爸一起生活了
我妈妈做先驱超过了25年
2007年她去世了
虽然小时候我跟妈妈不是那么亲近
但长大后我们却成了最好的朋友
妈妈去世时告诉我
玛莉，你要回到耶和华身边
我觉得我不可能符合圣经的标准
我不想做虚伪的人
所以我没有继续学习
我知道崇拜上帝绝不能三心二意
妈妈死后，在她的葬礼上
一位姐妹给了我一本圣经
在圣经的首页，妈妈写道
给玛莉，到了乐园，再把书还给我吧
我好想念她
我知道只有回到耶和华身边
我才有机会再次跟她见面
可是我非常害怕
要是我又一次做不到怎么办？
每天晚上我都会像以前一样向耶和华祷告
我跟耶和华祷告的时候
对他说
耶和华，你知道我的感受
你了解我的内心
我很想再一次崇拜你，赞美你
耶和华，你了解我
求你让我清楚看出我应该怎么做
第2天，也就是8月20号
我去信箱拿信的时候看到了你的信
我简直不能相信
我太震惊了，然后坐下来想
哇！耶和华回应了我的祷告
我该做什么呢？
我应该采取行动，但我很紧张
我希望你可以帮助我做出必要的改变
但我真的很害怕
希望你可以帮助我踏出这一步
谢谢你
玛莉。”
这就是一封信产生的力量
没错，我们现在按下了“暂停键”
不能像以前一样做我们喜欢做的工作
但我们因此失去了价值了吗？
耶和华仍然与我们同在
我们在上帝眼中没有失去价值
耶和华绝不会舍弃我们
那我们该怎么做呢？
像耶稣一样
我们不要留恋过去做的事
而是要尽全力做我们现在能做的事
这样就能够让我们最爱的天父耶和华高兴

ko.text: 이스라엘은 여호와를 섬기지 않는 친족 나라들로부터 많은 압력을 받았고,
하지만 그들은 주변 나라들의 영향을 받아
“나라들은 ‘반드시 내가 여호와인 줄 알게 될 것이다’”입니다.
이와 같은 선언이 에스겔의 예언에 여러 차례 나옵니다.
이 장의 주제 성구에도 같은 내용이 들어 있는데요.
“내가 그들에게 맹렬한 형벌을 내려 큰 복수를 집행하겠다.
내가 복수할 때에, 그들은 반드시 내가 여호와인 줄 알게 될 것이다.”
우리는 이스라엘 백성과 그 주변 나라들 사이에 있었던 일을 통해
그리고 여호와께서 그에 대해 나타내신 반응을 통해서도
이 내용을 예습할 때, 다음 질문들에 대한 답을 찾아 보십시오.
우리가 여호와를 숭배하는 것을 가족들이 반대할 수 있다는 점을
티레 사람들에게 있었던 일을 통해 무슨 교훈을 배울 수 있습니까?
여호와를 알고 있다는 점을 어떻게 나타낼 수 있습니까?
이 장을 연구하면서 이렇게 자문해 보십시오.
성서 연구생이나 다른 사람들을 도울 때
어떻게 이 요점들을 사용할 수 있을까?’
우리 모두가 여호와께 충성을 유지하는 것은 정말 중요합니다!
그래야만 여호와께 순결한 숭배를 드릴 수 있습니다.

en.text: ‎The Israelites had to deal with pressure from relatives
‎who did not serve Jehovah,
‎and Israel was surrounded by rich and powerful nations.
‎When the Israelites relied on Jehovah,
‎he protected them from their enemies.
‎Often, though, his people allowed themselves
‎to be corrupted by their neighbors.
‎How did Jehovah respond?
‎Chapter 7 has the title
‎“The Nations ‘Will Have to Know That I Am Jehovah.’”
‎That declaration appears repeatedly throughout Ezekiel’s prophecy.
‎The theme scripture for this chapter contains a similar thought.
‎Please read Ezekiel 25:17 with me:
‎“I will execute on them great acts of vengeance
‎“with furious punishments,
‎“and they will have to know that I am Jehovah
‎when I bring my vengeance on them.”
‎We can learn much by examining the way that the Israelites
‎interacted with the surrounding people
‎—including many who were related to them—
‎and the way that Jehovah responded.
‎So when you prepare this material,
‎look for the answers to these questions:
‎Why should it not surprise us
‎if family members oppose our worship of Jehovah?
‎About what should we remain confident
‎even if powerful governments persecute us?
‎What lesson can we learn from the inhabitants of Tyre?
‎And how can we show that we know Jehovah?
‎As you study this chapter, ask yourself,
‎‘How can I use the key points discussed to encourage someone,
‎‘such as a Bible student,
‎to prepare for opposition?’
‎It’s so important that all of us remain loyal to Jehovah!
‎Only then can we give him pure worship.

cn.text: 以色列人需要应付
不敬奉耶和华的近亲施加的压力
而他们也被繁荣强大的邻国包围
每当以色列人信赖耶和华
耶和华都保护他们不受敌人伤害
不过，上帝的子民
却一再容许自己受到邻国的腐化
耶和华采取了什么行动呢？
第7章的标题是
“列国‘就知道我是耶和华’”
这句话在以西结的预言中先后出现了很多次
本章的主题经文也表达了类似的思想
请跟我一起看看以西结书25:17
我们看看以色列跟那些与他们有血缘关系的民族
跟周围其他列国之间发生的事
看看耶和华采取了什么行动
就能学到很多道理
你预习这一章时
请找找以下问题的答案
如果家人反对我们崇拜耶和华
为什么我们不该感到惊讶？
即使被强大的政府迫害
我们也要对什么有信心？
我们从泰尔居民身上学到什么教训呢？
我们可以怎样表明自己知道耶和华是谁？
你研读本章时，请问问自己
我可以怎样运用这一章的要点去鼓励别人
例如圣经学生，要做好准备应付反对呢？
对我们来说，忠于耶和华多么重要！
只有这样
上帝才会把我们的崇拜
视为正确的崇拜！

ko.text: “합당한 성향을 가진” 많은 사람이 신자가 되고 있습니다.
이 세 나라의 활동을 돌보는 지부 사무실은
아내와 전 2018년 3월 지부 방문을 할 때
이 지부들에 가 볼 기회가 있었죠.
베델 가족들이 전파 활동을 지원하기 위해
그런 일들 중 하나로 이 지부들은
영적 양식을 11개 언어로 번역하는 일을 돌봅니다.
또한 왕국회관을 신축하고, 개축하고, 유지하는 일과
아르헨티나에서는 지부의 업무를 더 간소화하기 위해
그러면 전파 활동에 더 관심을 쏟을 수 있죠.
그러니까 지난 10년 동안 매일 15명씩 침례를 받은 셈입니다.
전파 활동에 대한 형제 자매들의 열심도 대단합니다.
봉사에 바친 시간도 280만 시간 가까이 늘어났습니다.
두 지부 모두 특별 전파 활동을 조직해서
임명되지 않은 구역이나 원주민 거주지에 찾아갑니다.
처음으로, 꽤 많은 원주민들이 사용하는 언어인 니바클레어로
그 출판물을 배부하기 위해 특별 활동이 조직되었습니다.
그 활동은 파라과이 북쪽 지역에 있는
한 마을에서 형제들은 그곳의 촌장과 대화를 나누었는데,
그는 자신의 언어로 된 출판물을 보고 매우 기뻐했습니다.
그는 니바클레어로 된 우리 동영상을 보더니
그리고 온 가족을 불러 동영상을 보게 했고
자신과 가족이 성서 연구를 하겠다고 했습니다.
형제들이 그 마을에서 모임을 가져도 되겠는지 묻자,
그는 좋다고 하면서 모든 주민을 초대해 주겠다고 했습니다.
한 형제는 파라과이의 자주 돌지 못하는
임명되지 않은 구역에서 특별 활동에 참여했습니다.
대화를 끝내고 다음 집에 가기가 너무 힘들었다’고
그들이 방문한다고 입소문을 내 주는 곳도 있었습니다.
그래서 우리 형제 자매들이 구역에 도착해 보면,
이미 의자를 준비해 놓고 기다리고 있었습니다.
집회 장소를 짓도록 땅을 내놓기도 했습니다.
한 작은 상점의 주인은 듣고 있는 왕국 소식이 너무 좋아서
물건을 사러 온 손님들에게 이렇게 말했습니다.
어느 날 오후 두 자매가 봉사를 하면서
칼데라시 집시어를 쓰는 사람의 집 같다고 적혀 있었습니다.
그러더니 자기가 남아메리카 최남단에서 왔다고 설명하면서
이웃 사람과 성경 공부를 하고 있었다고 했죠.
일주일에 세 번 이웃을 만나서 성서 연구를 계속했습니다.
소녀가 여전히 연구하고 있는 걸 알게 된 가족은
연구 사회자는 소녀가 멀리 가게 되었다는 말을 듣고
여호와께 계속 기도하면서 증인들을 찾아보라고 했습니다.
그냥 집집마다 전도하고 계셨나요?” 하고 물었습니다.
칼데라시 집시어를 쓰는 사람을 찾고 있었다고 대답했습니다.
그리고 부에노스아이레스에 온 지 얼마나 됐냐고 묻자
방금 말씀드린 대로 바로 오늘 아침에 떠나서 온 거예요!
눈을 떠 보니까, 문 앞에 두 분이 서 계신 거예요.”
「여호와의 친구가 되세요」 동영상을 번역하는 획기적인 일이 있었습니다.
자기들의 모국어로 말하는 것을 보고 놀랐습니다.
그분에 대한 사랑이 더 커지게 되었습니다.
교도소에 있는 사람들도 좋은 소식을 듣고
그런데 이제는 사람들이 그를 완전히 다르게 봅니다.
웨키드 형제는 50년 형을 선고받고, 지금 6년째 수감 중입니다.
그는 삶에서 가장 큰 믿음의 시험이 되었을 일을 겪었습니다.
그의 이전 친구들이 그가 어떤 불법적인 수단을 쓰기만 하면
가택 연금으로 지낼 수 있다고 알려 준 것입니다.
그렇게 하면 사랑하는 가족들과 함께 있을 수 있었는데,
웨키드 형제는 올바른 결정을 내리기가 아주 힘들었습니다.
남은 형기를 교도소에서 다 채우기로 결정했습니다.
그 일은 이전 친구들과 증인이 아닌 가족들과
형제는 여호와와의 관계를 첫째 자리에 두기 위해
웨키드 형제는 현재의 상황에서도 기쁨을 누리고 있습니다.
성서 연구를 6건 사회하고 감방을 다니며 증거합니다.
또 형제는 재소자의 가족이 접견하러 오는 날
교도소의 공용 공간에 출판물을 전시해 놓는데,
이 나라들에서 여호와를 위해 더 많은 일을 하려는
훌륭한 젊은 형제 자매들을 보면서 큰 격려를 받았습니다.
이들은 새로운 언어를 배우고, 왕국 전파자 학교에 참석하고,
베델 봉사에 지원하고, 지역 설계/건축부에서 일하면서,
왕국회관을 신축하고 개축하고 유지하는 일을 돕습니다.
왼쪽은 레안드로 타물라, 오른쪽은 아리 나바로입니다.
아리는 축구에 대한 열정이 대단한 가정에서 자랐습니다.
아리의 꿈은 언젠가 국가 대표 팀에서 뛰는 것이었죠.
유명한 축구 팀 두 곳에서 제의를 받았습니다.
아주 좋아하는 팀들이라 그 제의에 정말 마음이 끌렸습니다.
축구에 대한 열정 때문에 매우 힘든 결정이었지만,
여호와를 섬기기로 이미 결심한 아리는 그 제의를 거절했습니다.
국가 대표 팀에서 뛰라는 제의를 받았습니다.
국제 경기에도 나갈 수 있는 기회였죠.
그런데 두 주인을 섬길 수 없다는 걸 깨달았습니다.
어떻게 인생을 살아가야 할까?」 를 보고,
그 어떤 스포츠에서 얻는 것보다 훨씬 더 큰 만족감을 얻고 있다고
훌륭한 형제 자매들에 대한 경험담이 많이 있습니다.
지부 위원들과 베델 가족들은 야외 활동을 조직하는 일에 더해,
두 나라에서 봉사에 함께 참여할 기회를 가졌습니다.
또한 우리는 두 차례 모임을 가졌는데,
우린 이 나라들의 활동에 관한 보고를 듣고 큰 격려를 받았고,
이 놀라운 조직에 속해 있는 게
아르헨티나, 파라과이, 우루과이의 많은 형제 자매들은
여호와의 집에 몰려드는 모든 사람을 도우며
지부와 야외에서 수행되는 흥미진진한 일들을 즐겁게 하며

en.text: As was true in the first century,
many who are “rightly disposed for everlasting life” are becoming believers.
This truly is the case
in the countries of Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay.
The work in these three countries is cared for
by the branch offices in Argentina and Paraguay.
Faith and I had the privilege of visiting these branches
on a branch visit in March 2018.
Both branches have beautiful Bethel families
who are working hard to support the activity in the field.
Among the work taking place,
these branches take care of the translation of spiritual food
into 11 languages.
They are also busy building, renovating, and maintaining Kingdom Halls
and caring for the needs of the congregations.
In Argentina, a new branch facility is being built
to help further simplify the work of the branch
so that even more attention can be given to the field.
Eleven brothers serve on the Branch Committee in Argentina,
and six brothers serve on the Branch Committee in Paraguay.
These loyal and faithful men are working hard to support the Governing Body,
and they are looking for ways to find even more
who want to learn about Jehovah.
The result of their hard work and Jehovah’s blessing is most evident.
In 2017, over 200 percent
of the 173,000 publishers in these three countries
attended the Memorial.
In the past ten years, over 55,000 persons
have been baptized.
That is the equivalent of 15 persons baptized every day of the week
for the past ten years!
There is also a fine zeal for the preaching work.
Just in the last year alone,
the number of pioneers increased by about 16 percent
and nearly 2.8 million more hours were put in in the ministry.
Both branches have organized
special preaching campaigns to reach those in unassigned territories
or to reach indigenous populations.
These initiatives have had much success.
For the first time, publications were translated into Nivaclé,
a language spoken by a sizable indigenous population.
To distribute the literature, a campaign was organized
in the northern territory of Paraguay called El Chaco.
In one location, the brothers talked with the head of the community,
and he was very happy to see publications in his own language.
When he saw one of our videos in Nivaclé, he started to cry.
He called his entire family to watch the video
and asked for a Bible study for himself and his family.
When the brothers asked if they could have a meeting
in the community, he agreed and even offered
to invite all the people to the meeting.
One brother who shared in the campaign
to work unassigned and seldom-worked territory in Paraguay wrote,
“People showed so much interest in the good news that it was very difficult
to end conversations and go to another house.”
In some places, people spread the news of their visits by word of mouth.
So when our brothers and sisters arrived in a territory,
they found that many householders already had prepared chairs,
waiting for them to arrive.
Some householders invited them for lunch, offered lodging,
and even offered part of their property to build a meeting place.
A man who was the owner of a little store
was enjoying what he was hearing about the Kingdom message so much
that when some customers arrived to shop,
he told them: “Now I am very busy.
If you need something, come back later.”
In Buenos Aires, Argentina,
one afternoon while in the ministry, two sisters approached a house
that was listed in the territory records as a possible address
for a Romani Kalderash speaker.
A 14-year-old Romani girl ran out to them and asked,
“Are you Jehovah’s Witnesses?”
When they replied that they were, she exclaimed,
“Jehovah sent you!”
She explained that she was
from the southernmost tip of South America.
She’d been studying the Bible with her neighbor,
but her family was very opposed and took her Bible
and Bible Teach  book away.
Even so, she would secretly sneak away
three times a week to meet her neighbor and continue her Bible study.
When her family found out that she was still studying,
they decided to send her about 3,000 kilometers,
or 1,800 miles, away to Buenos Aires
so that she would not be able to contact the Witness
whom she was studying with anymore.
When her Bible teacher heard that she was being sent far away,
she wrote a letter to the young girl,
saying that no matter where she ended up,
she should keep praying to Jehovah and try to find the Witnesses.
After relating the story, the young girl asked,
“Were you sent by my teacher,
or were you just preaching from house to house?”
The sisters replied, saying that they were preaching in the area,
looking for Romani Kalderash speakers.
They then asked the girl how long she had been in Buenos Aires.
She said: “I arrived today!
“What I just told you happened today!
“I left this morning, and after arriving here,
“I started to pray to Jehovah.
When I opened my eyes, I saw you standing at my door.”
Arrangements were made to follow up on her interest.
In Argentina, the branch reached a milestone in the Wichí language
by translating the Become Jehovah’s Friend  videos.
The response was beyond expectations.
Children and adults alike were amazed to see the characters
speaking in their native tongue.
As a result of this project, the Wichí people feel that they are not forgotten by Jehovah,
and this helps their love for him to grow even more.
Even those in prison are being reached with the good news
and are taking a stand for the truth.
Consider the experience of Jesús Wekid.
Formerly, he was considered a dangerous inmate.
In fact, the prison kept him guarded by a whole security team.
Yet, others now view him as completely the opposite.
Brother Wekid is serving a 50-year sentence,
of which he is now in his 6th year.
Last May, he went through
what was probably the biggest test of his faith yet.
His former friends proposed the idea
that through some illegal means he could get out of prison
and do the rest of the time in home custody.
Making the right decision was very difficult for Brother Wekid,
as this would have meant that he could be with his beloved family,
some of whom are also Witnesses.
After consulting with his family with many tears, he decided
to serve out the rest of his sentence in prison,
giving a great witness to his former friends, non-Witness family members,
and all of the prison inmates.
He gave up his freedom to put his relationship with Jehovah first.
Now Jesús has found joy even despite his current circumstances.
He conducts six Bible studies and witnesses from cell to cell.
In one of the general areas of the prison, he displays the publications
during the visitation days for the families of the inmates,
with very positive results.
It was so encouraging to see
the outstanding young brothers and sisters in these countries
and their desire to do more for Jehovah.
Many are learning new languages,
going to the School for Kingdom Evangelizers, reaching out for Bethel service,
and working with their Local Design/Construction Department
to help build, renovate, and maintain Kingdom Halls.
This is Leandro Támula on the left and Ary Navarro on the right.
Ary was part of a family
that was truly passionate for football, or soccer.
It was Ary’s dream to be a part of the national team someday.
Ary excelled at the sport
and received offers from two national football teams.
These were especially tempting offers because these were his two favorite teams.
Even though it was a hard decision for him because of his passion for the sport,
he had already decided to serve Jehovah and he turned down the offers.
Leandro had a similar test but with a different sport.
Leandro excelled at basketball
and received an offer to play for the national team,
which included a chance to play internationally.
He realized that he could not serve two masters.
After watching the video Young People Ask —What Will I Do With My Life?
he made the decision to serve Jehovah.
Both of these young men serve together at the branch in Argentina.
They feel that the decisions they have made have brought them
so much happiness and fulfillment in life.
They say that they are receiving much more satisfaction
than a life in sports would have ever provided.
These are just a few of the many experiences
of the outstanding brothers and sisters serving in these countries.
In addition to organizing the work in the field,
the members of the Branch Committee and Bethel families
are themselves active in the field ministry.
While on the visit, we had the opportunity to engage in the ministry
in both countries with them and had a very encouraging time.
Additionally, we had the privilege of having two meetings,
with a combined attendance of nearly 200,000.
We were greatly encouraged by hearing reports of the work in these countries
and were reminded of the privilege we have
to be part of this incredible organization.
The many brothers and sisters in Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay
count it a privilege to work with you “shoulder to shoulder”
in helping all those who are streaming to the house of Jehovah.
Like you, they are joyfully keeping busy
in the exciting work going on in our branches and in the field in these last days.

cn.text: 像1世纪一样
现在很多“有正确的态度
而可以得到永远生命的人”
也成了信徒
在巴拉圭、阿根廷和乌拉圭的情况也是这样
阿根廷和巴拉圭的分部办事处
负责照顾这3个国家的传道活动
我和太太有荣幸探访这两个分部
两个分部的弟兄姐妹都充满爱心、团结合作
非常努力地支持传道工作
他们把滋养信心的食物翻译成11种语言
他们也会建造、翻新、保养聚会所
也会照顾会众的需要
在阿根廷，为了进一步简化分部工作
弟兄们正在建造一个新的分部设施
这样就可以有更多人去传道了
阿根廷分部委员会有11个弟兄
巴拉圭分部委员会则有6个弟兄
这些忠心的弟兄努力支持中央长老团
也不断寻找方法
想要找到更多想认识耶和华的人
他们努力工作，耶和华赐福给他们
因此取得了很好的成果
这3个国家的传道员人数
共有17万3000人
但参加耶稣牺牲纪念聚会的人数
是传道员的两倍多
过去十年，有5万5000多个人受浸了
也就是说，过去的十年间
每天都有15个人受浸！
那里的弟兄姐妹传道非常热心
光是去年一年
先驱的人数就增加了大约百分之16
弟兄姐妹的传道时间
增加了将近280万个小时
为了向住在未分配地区的人或原住民传道
两个分部都组织了特别传道活动
这些传道活动取得了巨大的成功
有很多原住民说尼瓦雷语
所以组织第一次把出版物翻译成了这种语言
为了分发我们的出版物
弟兄们在称为厦谷的巴拉圭北部
组织了一个特别传道活动
在一个地方，弟兄们向一个部落的首领传道
他非常高兴能够看到自己语言的出版物
当他看到一个尼瓦雷语的短片时
竟然哭了起来
他也叫他的所有家人出来看那个短片
而且说他和家人都想学习圣经
弟兄们问他
可不可以在这个部落举行一个聚会
他同意了
而且主动帮忙邀请那里的所有人来参加聚会
一个弟兄在去巴拉圭
未分配的和不常探访的地区传道后，写道
“那里的人对真理非常感兴趣
很难跟他们结束谈话，然后去下一家传道。”
在一些地方，我们拜访过的人
会告诉其他人我们的传道活动
所以当弟兄姐妹到了传道地区以后
发现很多人已经在门口准备好椅子
等着他们来了
有些家庭邀请他们一起吃午饭，还提供住宿
甚至还会给他们一块空地
让他们盖聚会的地方
有一个小商店的老板非常喜欢听圣经的信息
所以有顾客来的时候，他就会告诉他们
“我现在很忙
如果你需要买东西，一会儿再来吧！”
在阿根廷的布宜诺斯艾利斯
有一天下午
两个姐妹按照地区卡上的地址
去拜访可能说罗姆语的住户
有一位14岁的
说罗姆语的女孩跑出来问她们说
“你们是耶和华见证人吗？”
两位姐妹说她们是
这位女孩就兴奋地说
“是耶和华派你们来的！”
她说她是从南美洲的最南端来的
她一直跟她的邻居学习圣经
但她的家人非常反对
还拿走她的圣经和《圣经真理》书
虽然如此
她还是偷偷地跑出去跟邻居学习
一周学习3次
她的家人发现她还在学习圣经
就把她送到3000公里以外的
布宜诺斯艾利斯
他们以为
这样她就再也不能跟那个耶和华见证人
学习圣经了
她的圣经老师听说她要被送走
就写了一封信给她，对她说
不管她要去哪里，都要不断祷告
一定要努力找到耶和华见证人
这个女孩说完她的经历后问道
“是我的圣经老师让你们来的
还是你们在做挨家挨户的传道？”
两个姐妹说她们在这个地区传道
她们在找说罗姆语的人
接着姐妹问这个女孩她到这里多久了？
她说
“我今天才到！
我告诉你们的事是今天发生的！
今天早上我离开家到这里以后
我就开始向耶和华祷告
我睁开眼睛的时候
就看到你们站在门口。”
姐妹就作出安排，帮助她继续学习圣经
阿根廷分部
把《成为耶和华的朋友》系列动画片
翻译成了威奇语
这是一个里程碑
人们的反应出乎我们的意料
不管是小孩还是大人
他们看到动画片里的人物用他们的母语说话
就感到非常兴奋
这些动画片让威奇人觉得
耶和华没有忘记他们，他们更爱耶和华了
就连那些在监狱里的囚犯也能听到好消息
开始崇拜耶和华
我们来看看赫苏斯·韦基德的经历
以前他被看作是一个非常危险的囚犯
监狱派很多狱警专门看管他
但现在人们对他的看法完全改变
韦基德弟兄被判了50年监禁
现在是第6年
去年5月，他的信心受到了非常大的考验
他以前的朋友告诉他
他可以用一些非法的方式离开监狱
在家里服刑
对韦基德弟兄来说
作出正确的决定非常难
因为这可能是一个跟家人团聚的好机会
有些家人还是耶和华见证人
他一边哭一边跟家人商量
最后决定继续在监狱服刑
这给以前的朋友、未信的家人
还有监狱的所有囚犯，作了非常美好的见证
他最重视的是跟耶和华的关系
所以他放弃了自由
虽然他现在没有自由，但他还是找到了喜乐
他主持6个圣经课程，也去每一个牢房传道
在探监日
他在监狱的公共区域展示我们的书刊
这样就可以向囚犯的家人作见证
这也带来了很好的成果
看到这里年轻的弟兄姐妹都非常热心
想要为耶和华做更多服务
我们都非常受鼓励
很多人学习新的语言
参加王国传福音者训练班
申请伯特利服务
也在本地设计及建筑部帮忙建造
翻新、保养王国聚会所
左边的弟兄是莱安德罗，右边的弟兄是阿里
阿里全家都非常喜欢足球
他从小的梦想就是有一天可以进入国家队
阿里很会踢足球
结果有两个很有名的足球队都邀请他加入
这两个队都是他最喜欢的
这是很大的诱惑
他非常喜欢运动
所以这个决定对他来说很困难
但他还是选择崇拜耶和华
拒绝了这两个邀请
莱安德罗也遇到了类似的考验
但他喜欢的运动不一样
他很会打篮球
所以受到邀请进入国家队
而且还有机会参加国际比赛
但他发现他不能做两个主人的奴隶
在看过《青年人问——我该怎样运用一生》
这部影片后
他决定崇拜耶和华
这两个弟兄都在阿根廷分部服务
他们觉得现在的生活非常快乐
而且充满意义
他们说
他们现在得到的满足感是运动无法带来的
在这几个国家
还有很多像他们一样优秀的弟兄姐妹
除了安排组织传道工作以外
分部委员会成员和伯特利家庭成员
自己也非常热心参与传道工作
探访期间
我们有机会跟两个分部的弟兄姐妹一起传道
他们的热心很鼓励我们
我们也安排了两个特别的聚会
总共有将近20万个人参加
聚会时
我们聆听了这两个分部的传道工作报告
深受鼓励
这也再次提醒我们
能够成为这个了不起的组织的一分子
真的非常荣幸
在阿根廷、巴拉圭
以及乌拉圭的弟兄姐妹都觉得
能够并肩帮助人成为上帝家里的人
是一件非常光荣的事
像你一样，在这最后的日子
他们都快乐地在分部和传道地区
为耶和华服务

title: 기념식 아침 숭배—M. 스티븐 레트: ‘그 영이 우리의 영과 함께 증언합니다’ (로마 8:16)

ko.text: 출판 위원회의 보조자이신 로버트 루시오니 형제가
이 아침 숭배 프로그램을 통해 만나게 되어서
오늘은 우리 모두에게 아주 특별한 날입니다.
고대 유대인 달력으로 니산월 14일이 시작될 것입니다.
자신의 완전한 인간 생명을 기꺼이 바치셨습니다.
첫 조상 아담과 하와에 관한 기록을
영원히 살 수 있다는 것을 분명히 알려 주셨습니다.
어떤 슬픈 일이 있었는지 우리 모두 알죠.
반역적인 태도를 나타낸 사탄 마귀에게 속아
그 일은 우리에게 어떤 영향을 줬을까요?
죄가 세상에 들어오고 죄를 통해 죽음이 들어왔으며,
심각한 유전적 결함이 후손에게 유전되는 것처럼,
아담과 하와의 후손에게도 죄와 죽음이 유전되었습니다.
신세계역 영문 성경에는 방금 읽은 12절 끝에
그 구절에서 사상을 끝맺지 않았기 때문입니다.
그리스어로 이 구절에 나온 특정 표현을 보면,
그 표현과 호응되는 또 다른 표현이 나와야
사상이 완결된다는 걸 알 수 있죠.
죽음에 대한 책임이 누구에게 있는지 밝혔습니다.
하지만 그 문제의 해결책은 설명하지 않았습니다.
예수께서 우릴 위해 그분의 생명을 주신 덕분에,
영원한 생명을 누릴 전망을 가지고 있습니다.
대부분은 아름답게 회복된 땅에서 완전한 생명을
그게 바로 땅에 대한 여호와의 원래 목적이었습니다.
여호와께선 목적한 것이 무엇이든 반드시 이루십니다.
하늘에서 영원한 삶을 누릴 전망을 가진 사람들에 관해
메시아 왕국에서 예수와 함께 통치할 사람들이죠.
어떤 사람이 앞으로 하늘에서 섬기도록 기름부음받았다는 것을
예수께서 부활되시고 나서 얼마 후에 제자들에게 나타나셨고
특별한 선물을 기다리라고 말씀하신 내용이 나옵니다.
약 120명의 제자들이 위층 방에 모여 있었는데,
갑자기 하늘에서 거센 바람이 불어닥치는 듯한 소리가 나더니,
그들이 앉아 있는 온 집 안을 가득 채웠다.
예수와 함께 하늘에서 통치할 전망을 갖게 된
분명 그들은 그 경험을 잊지 못했을 것입니다.
성령이 자신들의 영과 함께 증언했다는 것을 말이죠.
그 중요한 사건이 있은 후엔 어땠을까요?
모두 120명의 제자들처럼 기적적인 경험을 하게 됩니까?
오순절 날 그 일이 있고 나서,
같은 날 새로 기름부음받은 수천 명의 사람들에 관해
그리고 각자 자기 죄를 용서받기 위해
그런데 그들이 침례를 받고 성령으로 기름부음을 받았지만,
동일한 날, 앞서 120명이 경험한 것과 같은
특별한 경험은 하지 못했다는 사실에 유의하셨습니까?
이 기록을 보면 질문이 또 생기는데,
기름부음받는 사람들은 언제나 침례를 받는 그날에
하느님의 영이 그들의 영과 함께 증언하는 것을 경험합니까?
사마리아가 하느님의 말씀을 받아들였다는 말을 듣고
두 사람은 내려가서 그들이 성령을 받도록 기도했다.
그들이 주 예수의 이름으로 침례를 받았을 뿐,
아직 그들 중 아무에게도 성령이 내리지 않았기 때문이다.
그때에 두 사람이 그들에게 손을 얹자,
그들이 침례를 받은 지 얼마 후에 있었다는 것을 알게 되죠.
충실한 행로를 증명할 기회를 가진 후에 있게 됩니다.
그러면, 자신이 하늘에 갈 희망이 있다는 것을
그래서 여러분은 모두 지식을 가지고 있습니다.”
모든 것에 대해 여러분을 가르치고 있으며,
여호와께선 성령으로 해, 달, 별을 만드셨죠.
또 하늘과 땅의 모든 생명을 창조하셨습니다.
사실, 그분은 우주에서 의사소통을 가장 잘하시는 분이죠.
따라서 여호와의 강력한 성령이 작용할 때
그러면 하늘의 희망을 갖도록 성령의 증언을 받지 않은
하늘로 입양될 필요가 생기기 전부터 있던 희망이죠.
바로 낙원이 된 땅에서 영원히 살 희망입니다.
사실, 오늘의 성구의 몇 구절 뒤인
로마서 8:21은 인간 피조물에 관해 이렇게 말합니다.
“그 희망은 피조물도 썩어짐의 종살이에서 자유롭게 되어
하느님의 자녀로서 영광스러운 자유를 누리게 된다는 것입니다.”
따라서 우리의 희망이 하늘에 있든 땅에 있든,
전 세계에 있는 우리 여호와의 백성들 모두는
영원한 생명을 누릴 놀라운 희망을 고대합니다!
우리가 가진 놀라운 희망을 가능하게 해 준,
두 가지 역사상 가장 위대한 사랑의 행동을
로마 사람들에게 한 말을 보면 그 답을 분명히 알 수 있습니다.
그는 오늘의 성구뿐 아니라 다음과 같은 말도 했습니다.
‘여러분은 다시 두려움을 갖게 하는 종살이의 영이 아니라
기념식 주간 성서 읽기를 들어 보겠습니다.
해진 후, 그러니까 니산월 14일에 있었던 일들이
유월절 제물을 바쳐야 하는 무교절 날이 되자
“도시로 들어가면 물동이를 메고 가는 남자를 만날 것입니다.
그 사람이 들어가는 집으로 따라 들어가십시오.
“내가 제자들과 함께 유월절 식사를 할 방이 어디입니까?”
그러면 그 사람이 잘 갖추어진 큰 위층 방을 보여 줄 것입니다.
그래서 그들이 가서 보니 그분이 말씀하신 대로였다.
무교절 첫날, 곧 관례대로 유월절 제물을 바치는 때에,
그러자 그분은 제자들 가운데 둘을 보내며 말씀하셨다.
그러면 물동이를 메고 가는 남자를 만날 것입니다.
그가 잘 갖추어 준비된 큰 위층 방을 보여 줄 것이니,
그래서 제자들이 나가 도시에 들어가 보니
시간이 되자, 그분이 사도들과 함께 식탁에 앉으셨다.
여러분과 함께 이 유월절 식사를 하기를 간절히 바랐습니다.
내가 다시는 이 식사를 하지 않을 것이기 때문입니다.”
그분은 잔을 받으신 뒤 감사를 드리고 말씀하셨다.
이제부터 나는 하느님의 왕국이 올 때까지
포도나무에서 난 것을 다시는 마시지 않겠습니다.”
또 빵을 들어 감사를 드리시고 떼어 그들에게 주며 말씀하셨다.
“이것은 여러분을 위해 주는 내 몸을 의미합니다.
나를 기억하여 이 일을 계속 행하십시오.”
그분은 잔을 들어 그와 같이 하며 말씀하셨다.
“이 잔은 여러분을 위해 쏟는 내 피에 의한 새 계약을 의미합니다.
그러나 나를 배반하는 자의 손이 나와 함께 식탁에 있습니다.
사실, ‘사람의 아들’은 정해진 대로 자기 길을 가고 있습니다.
그렇지만 그를 배반하는 그 사람에게는 화가 있습니다!”
그러자 그들은 자기들 중에 대체 누가 그런 일을 하겠는가 하고
그런데 그들 중에 누구를 가장 큰 자로 볼 것인가에 대해
도리어 여러분 중에서 가장 큰 자는
인도하는 자는 섬기는 자와 같이 되어야 합니다.
식사를 하는 사람입니까, 아니면 시중드는 사람입니까?
그러나 나는 시중드는 사람으로 여러분 가운데 있습니다.
여러분은 내가 시련을 받는 동안 내 곁에 머물러 온 사람들입니다.
내 아버지께서 나와 계약을 맺으신 것처럼
나도 왕국을 위해 여러분과 계약을 맺습니다.
그리하여 여러분은 내 왕국의 내 식탁에서 먹고 마시며,
왕좌에 앉아 이스라엘 열두 지파를 심판하게 될 것입니다.
사탄이 여러분 모두를 밀처럼 체질하게 해 달라고 요구했습니다.
그러나 나는 당신의 믿음이 없어지지 않도록
당신이 돌아오거든, 당신의 형제들을 강하게 하십시오.”
“주여, 저는 감옥이든 죽음이든 주와 함께할 각오가 되어 있습니다.”
당신은 나를 안다는 것을 세 번 부인할 것입니다.”
“내가 여러분을 돈주머니와 식량 자루와 신발 없이 보냈을 때에
“그러나 이제 돈주머니가 있는 사람은 그것을 가지고 가고
그리고 칼이 없는 사람은 겉옷을 팔아서 사십시오.
‘그는 불법한 자들 중 하나로 헤아려졌다’라고 기록된 말씀이
늘 하시던 대로 올리브 산으로 가셨으며,
그리고 그들을 떠나 돌을 던지면 닿을 만한 곳으로 가서
아버지께서 원하신다면 이 잔을 제게서 거두어 주십시오.
그때에 한 천사가 하늘에서 그분에게 나타나
그분이 몹시 괴로워서 더욱 간절히 계속 기도하시니,
그분이 기도를 마치고 일어나 제자들에게 와 보시니,
유혹에 빠지지 않도록 일어나 계속 기도하십시오.”
그분이 아직 말씀하고 계실 때에 사람들이 몰려왔는데,
열두 제자 중 하나인 유다라는 사람이 그들을 이끌고 왔다.
그가 예수께 입 맞추려고 가까이 오자
그 사람들 중 하나가 대제사장의 종을 쳐서
그의 귀를 만져 낫게 해 주셨다.
그리고 예수께서는 자신을 잡으러 그곳에 온
“여러분은 강도를 잡듯이 칼과 몽둥이를 들고 왔습니까?
내가 날마다 성전에서 여러분과 함께 있을 때에는
불을 피워 놓고 함께 앉아 있었는데,
그런데 어떤 하녀가 불가에 앉아 있는 그를 보고는
얼마 후에, 다른 사람이 베드로를 보고 말했다.
“이 사람이 갈릴리 사람인 걸 보니 그와 함께했던 것이 틀림없소!”
“여보시오, 나는 당신이 무슨 말을 하는지 모르겠소.”
그가 말을 채 끝내기도 전에 곧 닭이 울었다.
그때에 주께서 돌아서서 베드로를 똑바로 바라보셨다.
당신은 나를 세 번 부인할 것입니다”
예수를 지키던 사람들이 그분을 조롱하며 때리기 시작했다.
그들은 그 밖에도 온갖 말로 그분을 모독했다.
수백만의 소중한 형제 자매들께 말씀드릴 수 있어서 기뻤습니다.
오늘 저녁 우리가 함께 모일 때,
우리는 같은 장소에 있든 그렇지 않든
이 그리스도의 죽음의 기념식을 거행할 것입니다.
그리스도의 희생은 우리 아버지 여호와께서 주신

en.text: Welcome to all!
We have with us Brother Robert Luccioni,
a helper to the Publishing Committee,
to read our scripture text for today.
Today is Saturday, March 27.
The text is taken from Romans 8:16:
“The spirit itself
“bears witness with our spirit
that we are God’s children.”
Thank you, Rob.
It is my great pleasure
to welcome all of you in our worldwide brotherhood
to our Morning Worship program.
And what a very special day this is for all of us!
After sundown tonight
will be the equivalent of Nisan 14
according to the ancient Jewish calendar.
On Nisan 14, 33 C.E.,
in harmony with Jehovah’s will,
Jesus willingly gave his perfect human life.
He did this to redeem mankind
from the sin of Adam, our first human father.
Likely, all of us are familiar with the account
of Adam and Eve, our original earthly parents.
When Adam was created,
he had the prospect of living forever.
That was Jehovah’s original purpose.
Of course, Jehovah made it very clear
that his enjoyment of everlasting life
was dependent on his obedience.
A simple, noncomplicated, easy-to-follow test of obedience
was established:
‘Don’t eat from one tree in the garden.’
Sadly, we all know what happened.
Under the influence of a renegade spirit creature,
Satan the Devil,
Eve partook of the fruit of that tree,
and Adam foolishly could not resist her offer,
and he did the same.
By disobeying God,
Adam lost the prospect of everlasting life.
But now, how did that affect us?
For the answer, please go to Romans chapter 5
and let’s read verse number 12:
“That is why, just as through one man [Adam]
“sin entered into the world and death through sin,
“and so death spread to all men
because they had all sinned—.”
You’ll notice that death came from sinful Adam;
it didn’t come from Jehovah.
Just as a serious genetic defect
can be passed on to one’s offspring,
when Adam and Eve had children,
they passed on the death sentence.
But did you notice that long dash
at the end of verse 12 that we just read?
Why is it there?
It’s because in Greek, Paul did not complete his thought.
He left a cliff-hanger.
In Greek, whenever a sentence starts with the words “just as,”
it should conclude with a clause
that includes the words “so also,”
thus completing the thought.
Well, in verse 12, Paul makes clear who is responsible for death.
“Just as through one man . . . , death spread.”
But he leaves the resolution of the problem hanging.
However, in verse 19, using the same Greek grammar,
Paul now completes the thought with “so also,”
thereby completing (we could say) the cliff-hanger.
Let’s read verse 19:
“For just as through the disobedience of the one man
“many were made sinners,
“so also
“through the obedience of the one person
many will be made righteous.”
Yes, Jesus is identified as the solution.
Thanks to Jesus giving his life in our behalf,
now we have the hope of everlasting life.
Some have the hope of everlasting life in heaven,
but the vast majority
have the hope of living forever in perfection
on a beautifully restored earth.
After all, that was Jehovah’s original purpose
for the earth —was it not?—
and whatever Jehovah starts,
he finishes.
But now, our text for today, Romans 8:16,
is referring to those who have the hope of everlasting life in heaven,
serving alongside Christ in his Messianic Kingdom.
Let’s read it again together.
Romans 8:16:
“The spirit itself bears witness with our spirit
that we are God’s children.”
But how does God’s spirit ‘bear witness’ with a person
so that he knows he has been anointed
for a future role in heaven?
Well, to reason on this, let’s go to the book of Acts.
And first, if you will, just scan Acts 1:4, 5,
which tell us about how Jesus appeared to his followers
a few days after he was resurrected
and instructed them to stay in Jerusalem
and wait for a special gift
—the holy spirit.
Well, true to Jesus’ words,
a few days later, on the day of Pentecost,
holy spirit was poured out.
About 120 disciples were assembled in an upper room,
and when that holy spirit filled them,
it was spectacular.
Let’s read about it in Acts chapter 2,
beginning in verse 2:
“Suddenly there was a noise from heaven,
“just like that of a rushing, stiff breeze,
“and it filled the whole house where they were sitting.
“And tongues as if of fire
“became visible to them
“and were distributed,
“and one came to rest on each one of them,
“and they all became filled with holy spirit
“and started to speak in different languages,
just as the spirit enabled them to speak.”
These 120 disciples
became the first ones to be anointed by holy spirit
and given the hope of ruling with Jesus in heaven.
Obviously, they would never forget that experience.
For a certainty, there was no question in their minds
that God’s spirit bore witness with their spirit.
But now, what about after that momentous event?
Would all of those chosen to be with Christ in heaven
have some miraculous display, as did the 120?
The answer is no.
To reason on this point,
let’s go to verses 37 and 38
of Acts chapter 2,
which talk about what happened to thousands
who became new anointed disciples later
on that very same day of Pentecost.
Notice, beginning in verse 37:
“Now when they heard this, they were stabbed to the heart,
“and they said to Peter and the rest of the apostles:
“‘Men, brothers, what should we do?’
“Peter said to them: ‘Repent,
“‘and let each one of you be baptized
“‘in the name of Jesus Christ for forgiveness of your sins,
and you will receive the free gift of the holy spirit.’”
Well, verse 41 indicates
there were about 3,000 who were baptized.
But did you notice that even though they were anointed
by holy spirit after their baptism,
they did not experience any of the spectacular manifestations
that the 120 had experienced earlier that very same day?
But now this raises another question:
Does this account mean that newly anointed ones
will have God’s spirit bear witness with their spirit
on the day of their baptism?
Again, the answer is no.
To reason on this, please go to Acts chapter 8
and lets notice a very interesting account
that begins in verse 14:
“When the apostles in Jerusalem heard
“that Samaria had accepted the word of God,
“they sent Peter and John to them;
“and these went down and prayed for them
“to get holy spirit.
“For it had not yet come upon any one of them,
“but they had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
“Then they laid their hands on them,
and they began to receive holy spirit.”
Well, these verses describe how the spirit bearing witness
with these anointed ones in Samaria
occurred sometime after their baptism,
and that is what occurs in our time.
Jehovah’s spirit bears witness with the person
sometime after his baptism
and after he or she has had an opportunity
to establish a course of faithfulness.
But now we ask: How does a person know clearly
whether he or she has the heavenly calling?
Well, please go to 1 John chapter 2,
and let’s get some help with that question.
First John 2:20:
“And you have an anointing from the holy one,
and all of you have knowledge.”
Such ones “have knowledge”;
they know for a certainty they’ve been anointed.
Now look at verse 27:
“And as for you,
“the anointing that you received from him
“remains in you,
“and you do not need anyone to be teaching you;
“but the anointing from him is teaching you
about all things and is true and is no lie.”
So anointed ones don’t need confirmation from anyone else;
their anointing is clear, true, affirmative.
Think about it:
The holy spirit is the most powerful force in the universe.
Jehovah used it to create the sun, moon, stars.
He used it to create all life in heaven and earth.
He also used it to communicate his message
to the Bible writers.
In fact, Jehovah is the greatest Communicator
in the universe.
So if his powerful holy spirit bears witness with a person,
he is not going to communicate,
“Maybe you have been called to heavenly life”
—leaving the person in doubt, a dilemma, a quandary.
No, it is going to be
an absolute, affirmative communication
—leaving the person with no question in his mind or heart.
So if a person is wondering
if he is anointed or not,
the answer is obvious, isn’t it?
He is not.
But what about the millions
who do not have this change of hope
communicated to them by God’s spirit?
Well, they have the glorious hope
that Jehovah originally purposed for mankind
—before there was any need for humans to be adopted to the heavens—
everlasting life in a paradise earth.
In fact, just a few verses after our text for today,
at Romans 8:21,
it says of human creation:
“The creation itself
“will also be set free from enslavement to corruption
“and have the glorious freedom
of the children of God.”
So whether our hope is life in heaven or life on earth,
how all of us as Jehovah’s people worldwide look forward
to our marvelous hope of everlasting life!
And later today, after sundown,
when we observe the memorial of the Lord’s Evening Meal,
we will commemorate (remember)
the two greatest acts of love that have ever been shown
that make our wonderful hope possible.
But now let’s ask Brother Robert Luccioni
to read the Watchtower  comments on our scripture for today.
“How does a person know that he or she has the heavenly calling?
“The answer is clearly seen in the apostle Paul’s words to those in Rome
“who were ‘called to be holy ones.’
“In addition to the words of today’s text, he told them:
“‘You did not receive a spirit of slavery causing fear again,
“‘but you received a spirit of adoption as sons,
“by which spirit we cry out: “Abba, Father!”’
“So by means of his holy spirit,
“God makes it clear to anointed ones
“that they have this heavenly calling.
“Jehovah leaves no doubt whatsoever in the minds and hearts
“of those who receive his invitation to go to heaven.
Anointed Christians do not need anyone to confirm that they are anointed.″
Thank you very much, Rob.
Now we look forward to our Memorial Bible reading for today.
We will have the daytime events of Nisan 13 read
from Luke chapter 22 and Mark chapter 14.
Then the events after sundown,
which would have been Nisan 14,
will be read from the latter part of Luke chapter 22.
The specific texts will appear on screen in your own language.
“The day of the Unleavened Bread now arrived,
“on which the Passover sacrifice must be offered;
“so Jesus sent Peter and John,
“saying: ‘Go and get the Passover ready for us to eat.’
“They said to him:
“‘Where do you want us to get it ready?’
“He said to them:
“‘Look! When you enter into the city,
“‘a man carrying an earthenware water jar will meet you.
“‘Follow him into the house that he enters.
“‘And say to the landlord of the house,
“‘“The Teacher says to you:
“‘“‘Where is the guest room where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’”
“‘And that man will show you
“‘a large, furnished upper room.
“Get it ready there.’
“So they left and found it just as he had told them,
and they prepared for the Passover.”
“Now on the first day of the Unleavened Bread,
“when they customarily offered up the Passover sacrifice,
“his disciples said to him:
“‘Where do you want us to go and prepare for you to eat the Passover?’
“With that he sent two of his disciples and said to them:
“‘Go into the city,
“‘and a man carrying an earthenware water jar will meet you.
“‘Follow him, and wherever he goes inside,
“‘say to the master of the house,
“‘“The Teacher says:
“‘“‘Where is the guest room where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’”
“‘And he will show you
“‘a large upper room, furnished and ready.
“Prepare it for us there.’
“So the disciples went out,
“and they entered the city
“and found it just as he said to them,
and they prepared for the Passover.”
“So when the hour came,
“he reclined at the table along with the apostles.
“And he said to them:
“‘I have greatly desired to eat this Passover with you
“‘before I suffer;
“‘for I tell you, I will not eat it again
“until it is fulfilled in the Kingdom of God.’
“And accepting a cup, he gave thanks and said:
“‘Take this and pass it from one to the other among yourselves,
“‘for I tell you, from now on,
“‘I will not drink again from the product of the vine
“until the Kingdom of God comes.’
“Also, he took a loaf,
“gave thanks, broke it,
“and gave it to them, saying:
“‘This means my body,
“‘which is to be given in your behalf.
“Keep doing this in remembrance of me.’
“Also, he did the same with the cup
“after they had the evening meal, saying:
“‘This cup means the new covenant
“‘by virtue of my blood,
“‘which is to be poured out in your behalf.
“‘But look! the hand of my betrayer is with me at the table.
“‘For, indeed, the Son of man is going his way
“‘according to what has been determined;
“‘all the same,
“woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!’
“So they began to discuss among themselves
“which one of them could really be about to do this.
“However, there also arose a heated dispute among them
“over which one of them was considered to be the greatest.
“But he said to them:
“‘The kings of the nations lord it over them,
“‘and those having authority over them
“‘are called Benefactors.
“‘You, though,
“‘are not to be that way.
“‘But let the one who is the greatest among you
“‘become as the youngest,
“‘and the one taking the lead as the one ministering.
“‘For which one is greater,
“‘the one dining or the one serving?
“‘Is it not the one dining?
“‘But I am among you as the one serving.
“‘However, you are the ones
“‘who have stuck with me in my trials;
“‘and I make a covenant with you,
“‘just as my Father has made a covenant with me, for a kingdom,
“‘so that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom,
“‘and sit on thrones to judge the 12 tribes of Israel.
“‘Simon, Simon, look!
“‘Satan has demanded to have all of you
“‘to sift you as wheat.
“‘But I have made supplication for you
“‘that your faith may not give out;
“‘and you, once you have returned,
“strengthen your brothers.’
“Then he said to him:
“‘Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death.’
“But he said:
“‘I tell you, Peter, a rooster will not crow today
“until you have denied knowing me three times.’
“He also said to them:
“‘When I sent you out without a money bag
“‘and a food pouch and sandals,
“you did not lack anything, did you?’
“They said: ‘No!’
“Then he said to them:
“‘But now let the one who has a money bag take it,
“‘likewise a food pouch,
“‘and let the one who has no sword
“‘sell his outer garment and buy one.
“‘For I tell you that what is written
“‘must be accomplished in me, namely,
“‘“He was counted with lawless ones.”
“For this is being fulfilled concerning me.’
“Then they said:
“‘Lord, look! here are two swords.’
“He said to them:
“‘It is enough.’
“On leaving, he went as was his custom
“to the Mount of Olives, and the disciples also followed him.
“On arriving at the place, he said to them:
“‘Carry on prayer so that you do not enter into temptation.’
“And he withdrew from them about a stone’s throw away,
“and he bent his knees
“and began to pray, saying:
“‘Father, if you want to,
“‘remove this cup from me.
“‘Nevertheless, let, not my will,
“but yours take place.’
“Then an angel from heaven
“appeared to him and strengthened him.
“But he was in such agony
“that he kept praying more earnestly;
“and his sweat became as drops of blood
“falling to the ground.
“When he rose from prayer and went to the disciples,
“he found them slumbering, exhausted from grief.
“He said to them:
“‘Why are you sleeping?
“‘Get up and keep praying,
“so that you do not enter into temptation.’
“While he was still speaking,
“look! a crowd,
“and the man called Judas,
“one of the Twelve, was leading them,
“and he approached Jesus to kiss him.
“But Jesus said to him:
“‘Judas, are you betraying the Son of man with a kiss?’
“When those around him saw what was going to happen, they said:
“‘Lord, should we strike with the sword?’
“One of them even struck the slave of the high priest,
“taking off his right ear.
“But in reply Jesus said:
“‘That is enough.’
“And he touched the ear and healed him.
“Jesus then said to the chief priests
“and captains of the temple
“and elders who had come there for him:
“‘Did you come out with swords and clubs
“‘as against a robber?
“‘While I was with you in the temple day after day,
“‘you did not lay your hands on me.
“But this is your hour and the authority of darkness.’
“Then they arrested him and led him off,
“and they brought him into the house of the high priest;
“but Peter was following at a distance.
“When they lit a fire in the middle of the courtyard
“and sat down together,
“Peter was sitting among them.
“But a servant girl,
“seeing him sitting in the light of the fire,
“looked closely at him and said:
“‘This man was also with him.’
“But he denied it, saying:
“‘I do not know him, woman.’
“After a short time
“another person saw him and said:
“‘You too are one of them.’
“But Peter said:
“‘Man, I am not.’
“And after about an hour had passed,
“another man began insisting strongly:
“‘Certainly this man was also with him,
“for he is, in fact, a Gal·i·leʹan!’
“But Peter said:
“‘Man, I do not know what you are saying.’
“And instantly,
“while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.
“At this the Lord turned and looked straight at Peter,
“and Peter recalled the statement of the Lord
“when he had said to him:
“‘Before a rooster crows today,
“you will disown me three times.’
“And he went outside and wept bitterly.
“Now the men who held Jesus in custody
“began to mock him, hitting him;
“and after covering his face,
“they kept asking:
“‘Prophesy! Who is it that struck you?’
And they said many other blasphemous things against him.”
Well, it has truly been a delight to speak today
with millions of you dear ones around the world
—you precious sheep in Jehovah’s flock.
Be assured that we love you all very, very much.
And may Jehovah be with all of us this evening
as we gather together, physically if possible,
but especially as we all gather together in spirit
to commemorate the most important event of the year
—the Memorial of Christ’s death,
which is an incomparable gift
from our Father, Jehovah.

cn.text: 欢迎大家！
首先请出版委员会助手
罗伯特·卢乔尼弟兄为我们朗读今天的经文
今天是3月27日星期六
经文来自罗马书8:16
“神圣力量本身和我们的心一起作证
表明我们是上帝的儿女。”
谢谢你，罗伯特弟兄
我真的非常高兴
可以欢迎全世界的弟兄姐妹
收看这个早晨崇拜的节目
对我们所有人来说，这是多么特别的一天！
根据古代犹太历
今天晚上日落之后就是尼散月十四日
公元33年尼散月十四日
按照耶和华的旨意
耶稣为我们献出了他完美的生命
耶稣这样做，是为了拯救人类
摆脱我们的祖先亚当所犯的罪
我们大多数人
应该都很熟悉关于亚当和夏娃的记载
亚当被创造时，他是可以永远活下去的
这是耶和华原本的旨意
当然，亚当也清楚地知道
他必须一直服从耶和华
才能享有永远的生命
耶和华的指令非常清晰、简单、容易理解
也就是
“你不可以吃园子里那棵树上的果子。”
很遗憾，我们知道
在反叛的天使魔鬼撒但的引诱下
夏娃吃了那棵树上的果子
而亚当也愚蠢地接受了妻子夏娃给他的果子
因为反叛上帝
亚当就这样失去了永远的生命
那么这跟我们有什么关系呢？
答案就在罗马书的第5章
我们一起读第12节
“罪通过一个人进了世间
死又通过罪而来
于是死就传给所有人，因为人人都有罪。”
你注意到吗？
死是来自犯了罪的亚当，不是来自耶和华
就像人会把严重的基因缺陷
遗传给下一代一样
亚当和夏娃遗传给后代的
就是死亡
在英语圣经中
12节的最后部分有一个破折号
这是为什么呢？
因为在原文，也就是希腊语原文
保罗还没说完，只说到一半
在希腊语中，句子开头有“正如”这个词
按理说，在接下来的句子中
也会包含“也就”这个词，意思才会完整
在第12节
保罗明确指出，死是谁带来的
正如通过一个人，死就传给所有人
但没说谁会解决这个难题
不过在第19节
保罗用了同样的希腊语句式
但这次他把说到一半的话说完了
现在就让我们一起看看罗马书5:19
让我们一起读第19节
“因一个人的反叛，许多人就成了罪人
因一个人的服从
许多人也就会成为义人。”
是的，只有耶稣能彻底解决问题
因为他为我们牺牲他的生命
我们才可以有希望永远活下去
一些人的希望是在天上享有永生
而大部分人的希望
则是在地上重建的乐园里
享有完美的生命
其实这才是耶和华对地球原本的旨意
耶和华做事有始有终
一定会实现他的旨意
不过，我们今天的经文罗马书8:16
提到的是那些有希望到天上去的基督徒
他们会和耶稣一起在弥赛亚王国中作王
让我们再一起读一下罗马书8:16
“神圣力量本身和我们的心一起作证
表明我们是上帝的儿女。”
上帝的神圣力量
怎么和那些基督徒的心一起作证
知道自己有希望去天上呢？
为了说明这点，让我们一起打开使徒行传
首先请你大致浏览使徒行传1:4,5
经文告诉我们
耶稣在复活之后
吩咐门徒不要离开耶路撒冷
要在那里等待一份特殊的礼物
神圣力量
正如耶稣所说
不久之后，在五旬节的那一天
神圣力量倾注下来
大约120个门徒聚集在楼上的一个房间
当他们充满神圣力量时
发生了非常奇妙的事
让我们来读使徒行传第2章，从第2节开始
第2章第2节这里说
“他们坐着的时候，天上突然传来响声
像刮大风的声音，充满了整个房子
他们看见舌头般的东西
好像火苗，分别停留在每个人的头上
他们就充满神圣力量
并在神圣力量的指引下说起各种外语来。”
这120个门徒成为了第一批
有希望到天上和耶稣一起作王的基督徒
这样的经历，他们永远都不会忘记
我们可以肯定，他们一定不会怀疑
因为上帝的神圣力量已经和他们的心
一起作证
但是在这次重要的事情之后呢？
其他有希望到天上去的基督徒
也和这120个人一样看到奇迹发生吗？
并没有
我们怎么知道呢？
让我们一起来看使徒行传2:37,38
就在同一天，同一个五旬节
又增加了几千个有希望到天上去的基督徒
他们又经历了什么呢？
经文说
“当时，听见这番话的人都心如刀割
对彼得和其余的使徒说
“各位弟兄，我们该做什么呢？”
彼得说
“你们人人都要悔改，奉耶稣基督的名受浸
这样你们的罪就会得到宽恕
上帝也会把神圣力量无偿地赐给你们。”
41节提到
那一天有大约3000个人受了浸
虽然这些人也得到了神圣力量
有到天上去的希望
但他们和之前的120个人不一样
他们并没有看到或经历异乎寻常的奇迹
这让我们想到另一个问题
这段记载是不是也说明
有希望到天上去的基督徒
会在受浸当天得到神圣力量呢？
也不是
为了解释这点，让我们翻到使徒行传第8章
一起来看一段有趣的记载，从第14节开始
“耶路撒冷的使徒
听说撒马利亚人接受了上帝的话语
就派彼得和约翰到他们那里去
这两个人下到那里，为他们祷告
要让他们得到神圣力量
因为他们只是奉主耶稣的名受了浸
神圣力量还没有降在他们任何人身上
彼得和约翰把手放在他们身上
他们就得到了神圣力量。”
这些经文描述
当时撒马利亚的基督徒是在受浸一段时间后
才获得神圣力量
现在也是这样
一个人要先受浸
接着继续对耶和华表现信心
之后
上帝的神圣力量才会和他们的心一起作证
我们可能会问
一个人怎么能确定自己是否有希望
到天上去呢？
让我们来看约翰一书第2章
从那里找到问题的答案
约翰一书2:20
“你们受到那圣者的任命
人人都有知识。”
他们有知识，就是确定自己会去天上
现在看看第27节
“上帝用他的神圣力量任命了你们
这股力量时刻留在你们里面
你们不需要任何人教导
他的这股力量是真的，不是假的
正教导你们所有的事。”
一个人有希望到天上去
是不需要其他人确认的
这个希望是清晰、真实、十分肯定的
想想看
神圣力量是整个宇宙中最强大的力量
耶和华用它来创造太阳、月亮和星星
也创造了天上和地上的所有生命
他也用这股力量启示圣经的执笔者
和他们沟通
可以说，耶和华是全宇宙
最会沟通的一位
如果耶和华选择一个人到天上去
他不会只是说
“你可能会有希望到天上去”
让这个人陷入困惑、迷惘、无法确定
绝对不会
一个人能不能到天上去
耶和华会让他在心里、在头脑里
清楚知道这点
所以，如果一个人不确定自己是否会到天上
那答案很明显
他一定不会
还有非常多人没有通过神圣力量
得到去天上的希望
其实去天上的希望不是一开始就有的
耶和华原本的旨意是希望人类
在地上乐园里
享受永远的生命
在罗马书8:21就提到了
有希望在地上享永生的人， 21节说
“受造的众生会获得释放
不再像奴隶一样受制于会朽坏的身体
能够享有上帝儿女荣耀的自由。”
所以，不管我们的希望是在天上还是在地上
作为耶和华的子民
我们都非常期待在未来
可以永远享受美好的生命！
今天日落之后
当我们纪念耶稣的牺牲时
我们会想起耶和华和耶稣
为人类采取的有史以来最有爱心的两个行动
是他们让我们的希望能够实现
好
现在让我们请罗伯特·卢乔尼弟兄
为我们读出今天《守望台》的评论
一个人怎么知道
自己被上帝用神圣力量任命了呢？
保罗写信给罗马的基督徒
对这些“受呼召做圣民的人”
说了今天的经文
他还说
“你们得到的神圣力量
没有让你们做奴隶，没有让你们再感到害怕
你们得到的神圣力量
让你们被上帝收养为儿子了
神圣力量使我们呼唤
“爸爸，父亲！”
所以
上帝通过神圣力量使受到呼召的基督徒确信
自己有希望去天上
那些被耶和华任命的人
对自己的希望毫不怀疑
他们不需要别人确认他们得到上帝的任命
谢谢你，罗伯特弟兄
现在
让我们一起来读今天纪念耶稣牺牲的经文
包括记载在路加福音22章
和马可福音14章
关于尼散月十三日日间发生的事
以及在路加福音22章后面的部分
这是在尼散月十四日日落后发生的事
你会在荧幕上看到经文的范围
无酵节到了
在这一天要宰杀逾越节的祭牲
耶稣派彼得和约翰出去，说
“你们去，为我们准备逾越节的晚餐。”
他们说
“你要我们在哪里准备呢？”
他说
“你们进了城
就会遇见一个人拿着一个水瓶
你们要跟着他，到他进去的那个房子
你们要对房子的主人说
老师对你说
“我跟门徒一起吃逾越节晚餐的客房
在哪里呢？”
那个人就会带你们去看楼上一个宽敞的房间
里面家具齐全
你们就在那里准备吧。”
他们去了
发现情形正如耶稣对他们说的一样
他们就把逾越节的晚餐准备好了
无酵节的第一天
也就是人们按照惯例宰杀逾越节祭牲的那天
门徒对耶稣说
“你要我们去哪里
为你准备逾越节的晚餐呢？”
于是耶稣派了两个门徒
对他们说
“你们进城去
会遇见一个人拿着一个水瓶
你们要跟着他
他进哪个房子
你们就对哪个房子的主人说
老师说
“我跟门徒一起吃逾越节晚餐的客房
在哪里呢？”
他就会带你们去看楼上一个宽敞的房间
里面家具齐全，布置整齐
你们就在那里为我们准备吧。”
门徒出去，进了城
发现情形正如耶稣对他们说的一样
他们就把逾越节的晚餐准备好了
时候到了
耶稣和使徒一起用餐
耶稣对他们说
“我十分渴望在受难以前
跟你们一起吃这个逾越节的晚餐
我告诉你们
我不会再吃这个晚餐
直到所有跟这个晚餐有关的事
在上帝的王国里实现。”
他接过杯来
祷告感谢了，说
“你们拿去，大家传着喝
我告诉你们
从今以后，我不会再喝葡萄酒
直到上帝的王国来到。”
耶稣又拿起饼来，感谢上帝
掰开递给他们，说
“这指的是我的身体
是为你们牺牲的
你们要不断这样做来纪念我。”
晚餐过后
他又同样拿起杯来，说
“这杯指的是凭我的血订立的新约
我的血是为你们流出来的
“你们看，出卖我的人正跟我一起用餐
人子固然要按照指定的方式离去
可是出卖人子的人有祸了！”
他们就开始议论
到底他们当中谁会做出这种事来
可是，他们又激烈地争论他们哪一个算最大
耶稣对他们说
“列国的君王辖制人民
掌权管理他们的有‘恩主’的称号
可是你们不要这样
你们中间最大的，应该像最年轻的
带头的，应该像为人服务的
用餐的和在旁边服务的，哪一个大呢？
不是用餐的吗？
但我在你们中间是为你们服务的
“我受考验的时候，你们并没有离弃我
我父亲跟我立约，把王国赐给了我
现在我也跟你们立约
让你们也同得王国
这样你们就可以在我的王国里
跟我同席吃喝
并且坐在宝座上审判以色列12个部族
“西门，西门
撒但一直要筛你们所有人像筛小麦一样
可是我已经为你恳切祈求，免得你信心尽失
你回头以后，要帮助你的弟兄坚强起来。”
彼得说
“主啊，我已经准备好跟你一起坐牢
跟你一起死。”
耶稣说
“彼得，我告诉你
今天鸡叫以前，你会三次说你不认识我。”
耶稣又对他们说
“我先前派你们出去
你们没有带钱袋、粮袋和鞋子
那时你们有没有什么缺乏？”
他们说:“没有！”
耶稣说
“现在有钱袋的要带钱袋
有粮袋的要带粮袋
没有剑的要卖掉外衣去买剑
我告诉你们
圣经上写的‘他被人当作罪犯’这句话
一定应验在我身上
的确，跟我有关的事正在应验。”
他们说
“主啊，你看！这里有两把剑。”
耶稣说:“足够了。”
耶稣照常到橄榄山去
门徒也跟随他
到了那里，耶稣对他们说
“你们要不断祷告，免得陷入引诱。”
耶稣离开他们
走了扔一块石头那么远的距离
跪下来祷告，说
“父亲啊，如果你愿意
求你为我撤去这个杯
可是不要照我的意思去做
而是照你的意思去做。”
有一个天使从天上来到
出现在他面前，给他加添力量
他非常痛苦，祷告更加恳切
他的汗珠如血滴似的，滴在地上
祷告完了，他起来到门徒那里去
见他们因为忧愁而打盹
就对他们说
“你们为什么在睡觉？
起来，要不断祷告，免得陷入引诱。”
耶稣还在说话
有一群人来了
十二使徒中名叫犹大的带着他们
他上前去要亲吻耶稣
耶稣对他说
“犹大，你用亲吻来出卖人子吗？”
耶稣身边的人见情势不妙
就说:“主啊，我们拿剑砍好吗？”
他们有一个人甚至向大祭司的奴隶砍去
削掉了他的右耳
耶稣就说:“住手！够了！”
他摸摸那个人的耳朵，医好了他
耶稣对那些来捉拿他的祭司长
守殿官和长老说
“你们带着刀剑棍棒出来
像捉拿强盗一样吗？
我天天跟你们在圣殿里
你们也没有下手捉拿我
现在是你们的时候，黑暗掌权了。”
他们逮捕了耶稣，把他带走
押到大祭司的府第
彼得远远地跟着
他们在院子中生了火，一起坐下
彼得也坐在他们当中
有一个女仆看见彼得面向火光坐着
就盯着他，说
“这个人也是跟那个人一伙的。”
彼得却否认说:“姑娘，我不认识他。”
过了一会儿，又有一个人看见彼得，说
“你也跟他们是一伙的。”
彼得说
“老兄，我不是。”
大约一小时后
又有一个人一口咬定说
“这个人的确也是跟那个人一伙的
因为他是个加利利人！”
彼得说
“老兄，我不知道你在说什么。”
他的话还没有说完，鸡就叫了
主转过身来，看着彼得
彼得就想起主对他说过的话
“今天鸡叫以前，你会三次不认我。”
他就出去，痛哭了起来
拘禁耶稣的人戏弄他，打他
还把他的脸蒙住
问他说
“先知你说吧，打你的是谁啊？”
他们还说了许多亵渎他的话
今天真的很高兴
可以和全世界
数百万亲爱的弟兄姐妹们说说话
你们都是耶和华非常宝贵的绵羊
我们真的非常非常爱你们
今天晚上我们聚集起来时
愿耶和华与我们所有人同在
无论我们是否聚在一起，我们都团结一心
共同纪念一年中最重要的日子
纪念耶稣基督的牺牲
因为这是来自我们的天父耶和华
无与伦比的礼物

ko.text: 제 인생에 큰 영향을 준 성구들이 몇 구절 있습니다.
그분은 의로운 자가 넘어지도록 결코 내버려 두지 않으시리라.”
선발 징병 위원회의 심사를 받은 일이었습니다.
심사 결과 1-A 즉, 군 복무 해당자로 분류되었죠.
협회의 법률부에 문의를 했더니 제가 정규 파이오니아이기 때문에
그들은 여러 가지 질문들을 따져 물었습니다.
저를 전 시간 성직자로 볼 수 없다고 생각한 것입니다.
하지만 저는 그때 성서 연구를 12건 사회하고 있었고,
그래서 그 기록을 징병 위원회에 모두 제출했습니다.
“당신이 이 사람들 하나하나에게 매주 성경을 가르친다는 것을
이 사람들에게 직접 확인해 봐도 되겠소?”
여호와께 올바른 결정이 내려지게 해 달라고
며칠 뒤에 저는 4-D라고 분류된 카드를 받았습니다.
그 즉시 전 여호와께 정말 감사하다고 기도드렸습니다!
군인들의 위협을 받은 적이 몇 번 있었습니다.
그 당시는 참 이해하기 힘든 시절이었어요.
반군들은 원하면 그 누구에게나 총을 겨누었습니다.
한 번은 막 순회 방문을 마쳤을 때였는데,
우린 그 지역을 다니는 버스를 탔습니다.
그런데 두 명의 군인이 도로 위에서 버스를 세웠고,
그들은 한 사람씩 살펴보면서 버스로 돌려보냈습니다.
누구냐고 묻길래 설명을 했는데도 계속 총을 겨눴습니다.
군인 한 사람은 운전사에게 출발하라고 했어요.
저는 열렬히 기도하면서 잠언 29:25의 말씀을 생각했습니다.
늘 이 버스를 타세요”라고 절 변호해 주었습니다.
저는 분명 여호와의 천사가 도와줬다고 생각합니다.
그 경험을 통해서 또 한 번 느꼈죠.
봉사부의 임명에 따라 전 시간 봉사자로 일했습니다.
몇 년 뒤에는 전 시간 봉사를 그만 두고 가족을 돌봐야 했습니다.
오랜 시간 동안 전 시간 봉사를 했기 때문에
성경이 사람들에게 얼마나 큰 영향을 주는지 보면서
진리가 재소자들을 완전히 변화시키는 걸 볼 수 있죠.
성경은 사람들의 삶을 바꿀 수 있습니다.
그래서 늘 파이오니아를 다시 시작하고 싶었죠.
다시 전 시간 봉사를 시작하기로 마음먹었습니다.
지금까지 여호와께서는 저를 잘 돌보아 주셨어요.

en.text: Prayer is an important thing.
With everything I do,
I always go to Jehovah in prayer
and ask for his guidance.
I was born on the 26th of March, 1923
in Panama.
I was baptized in August 1946
in Cleveland, Ohio.
I started pioneering
in January of 1947.
There are a couple of scriptures that have been most influential in my life.
One is Psalm 55:22,
which says: “Throw your burden on Jehovah,
“and he will sustain you.
Never will he allow the righteous one to fall.”
One of the most trying experiences of my life
was facing the Selective Service Board.
I registered as was required by law,
and I received the classification of 1-A
—fit for military service.
I then spoke
with the Society’s Legal Department,
and I was instructed to appeal the decision
because I was a regular pioneer.
I had to go to the draft board,
and there I was severely questioned.
One of the problems they had
was that I had a part-time job,
and they felt that
that interfered with my being classified as a full-time minister.
However, because I was conducting
about 12 Bible studies at that time,
I took copies
of all those records and presented them to the board.
The chairman said to me,
“Are you saying that if we were
“to talk to all of these people, they would tell us
that you are conducting Bible studies with them every week?”
And I said, “Yes, Sir.”
While they are deliberating,
I am praying hard, “Jehovah, help them
to make a proper decision.”
In a few days’ time,
the classification card came as 4-D.
I was classified as a Religious Minister,
and I lifted my thoughts to Jehovah and said, “Thank you, Jehovah, very much!”
When I was in the circuit work in Cuba,
I had a few encounters with soldiers.
It’s difficult to understand
the tense atmosphere
that existed back in those days
and the freedom that those rebels had
with shooting people—even Batista’s people.
They didn’t give it a second thought.
I had just got through serving a congregation in the hills,
and we took the local bus
that ran around that area.
And on the highway,
two soldiers stopped the bus
and ordered all the men to get off.
They started looking at each of us one by one,
sending everybody back on the bus.
They looked at me and said: “You! Stay there!”
They pointed a rifle at me and said, “Who are you?”
And I explained myself,
but they kept pointing the rifle.
One of the soldiers said to the driver, “Take off!”
That’s when you pray hard,
and you remember the scripture at Proverbs 29:25:
“Trembling at men is a snare,
but the one trusting in Jehovah will be protected.”
The driver said: “No! He’s a circuit overseer!
He rides with me all the time.”
And he really defended me and made me believe
that Jehovah’s angels intervened.
And that’s why I say that I am a slave to prayer.
It’s the most important thing in my life.
When I came back to the United States,
I was being used
by the Service Department in the full-time work.
A few years later,
I had to give up the full-time work
and take care of my family.
The adjustment I had to make
to be a family man was hard
because most of my life was occupied in full-time service.
But I had to leave matters
in Jehovah’s hands.
We started the prison ministry
around May of 1974.
It gives you a measure of satisfaction
in seeing how the Bible
has a very strong influence
on individuals —to see criminals
turn their life completely around.
The Bible changes lives,
and that’s why pioneering has always been in my heart.
And so after my wife died,
I felt that the proper thing to do
was to get back into the full-time service.
As a result of that,
I started pioneering again in 1998.
Jehovah God has been good to me, and at my age of 96,
I thank Jehovah every day
for the health and strength that he permits me to enjoy
—and I keep on going.

cn.text: 祷告非常重要
我不管做什么事
都会先向耶和华祷告
寻求他的指引
我在巴拿马出生
我在俄亥俄州的克利夫兰受浸
1947年1月，我开始做正规先驱
有几节经文对我影响深远
其中一个是诗篇55:22
经文说
我经历过的一个很大的挑战
是要面对征兵委员会
我按照法律登记了
后来就收到了兵役通知
要我去服兵役
我联络了组织的法律部
他们告诉我，因为我是个正规先驱
我可以提出上诉
后来我去了征兵局
他们严厉地质问我很多问题
他们质疑我的一个问题是
因为当时我有一份兼职的工作
所以他们认为我不能被算作是全职的传教士
不过，当时我主持了12个圣经课程
所以我把这些报告拿给征兵局的人看
他们的一个主席问我
“你的意思是，如果我们问这些人
他们会告诉我们
你每个星期都会去跟他们讲圣经吗？”
我说:“是的，长官”
在他们审议期间，我向耶和华恳切祷告说
“耶和华，求你帮助他们做出正确的决定”
几天之后，结果出来了
我被归类为一名传教士
我马上感谢耶和华
“谢谢你，耶和华，真的非常感谢你！”
我在古巴做分区监督的时候
有几次遇到了士兵
你很难想象，那个时候情势有多么紧张
叛乱者会开枪射杀任何人
包括那些为当时的领导人巴蒂斯塔工作的人
他们杀人真的不眨眼
有一次我去探访一个会众
是在山上的
我们坐一辆公共汽车去那里
在路上的时候
有两个士兵拦下了我们的公共汽车
命令所有人下车
他们仔细看我们每一个人
然后叫大家回车上
但他们突然看着我说
“你，留下来！”
他们用步枪指着我问:“你是谁？”
我回答了，但他们还是用枪指着我
一个士兵对司机说
“开走吧”
当时，我非常恳切地祷告
我记得箴言29:25说
“战兢惧怕人，就是自设网罗
信赖耶和华，却会得到保护。”
但司机说
“他是个分区监督，他常常坐我的车”
他的话救了我一命
我相信，一定是耶和华的天使出手帮了我
所以我真的非常喜欢祷告
这是我生命中最重要的事
后来，我回到了美国
组织就委派我做代理分区监督的工作
几年以后，我不得不放弃全时服务的工作
因为我要照顾我的家人
我之前大部分时间都是做全时服务
所以我很难适应这个改变
我必须要完全依赖耶和华
1974年5月，我们开始作监狱见证
看到囚犯们彻底改变了他们的生活
这让我看出，圣经对人的影响非常强大
让我觉得我做的工作非常有意义
圣经能改变人的一生
所以我一直想要再次开始做先驱
我妻子去世后
我觉得我应该再次开始全时服务
所以，我就在1998年又开始做先驱了
耶和华上帝一直对我非常好
我96岁了
每天我都感谢耶和华赐给我健康和体力
能够为他服务
我一定会永远敬奉他

ko.text: 그때는 제가 여호와의 증인이 될지 안 될지 몰랐죠.
남편이 계속 연구를 할 거라는 걸 알았을 때,
어떤 식으로든 못 하게 막을 거야.”
남편이 봉사 나갈 준비를 하는 것만 봐도 짜증이 났어요.
남편이 집안일을 점점 더 많이 하게 만들었어요.
저는 또 화가 나서 이렇게 말했죠.
제가 그렇게 연구를 못하게 하려고 온갖 방법을 다 썼기 때문에
남편이 침례를 받은 후에는 제가 더 심하게 했어요.
하지만 남편은 전혀 화를 내지 않았고 잘 참았죠.
물론 그렇게 하는 게 쉽지는 않았지요.
저를 비난하고 거친 말을 하는 걸 들으면서
그러면 사회자 형제는 저를 격려하며 이렇게 말했죠.

en.text: I started to study the Bible in 1993.
At that time, I was 43 years old.
I was married for 19 years, and I had two children.
At that time, I didn’t know if I would become
one of Jehovah’s Witnesses or not.
But I accepted a Bible study.
At my husband’s request, I started studying the Bible at the same time,
but I only studied for about a year.
Then I decided, ‘I’m going to stop.’
I asked him to stop studying too.
I told him: “Let’s stop studying.
“This is not for us.
We don’t understand it.”
But in a very diplomatic and calm way,
he said he would continue.
When I realized he would continue studying, I said to myself:
‘Well, all right then.
‘Just you wait and see.
‘If you really want to continue, I will somehow make you stop studying
(in a subtle way), but I will do it.’
Just seeing him get ready to go in field service annoyed me so much.
I started burying him with household chores,
asking him to help me more and more around the house.
But calmly and gently every time,
he would ask me if he could prepare for meetings.
And one time when he asked me if he could prepare for the meeting,
yet again I got irritated and said:
“You’re not going to prepare now.
We’re going to clean the whole apartment thoroughly.”
After we were finally finished at midnight,
he asked me very calmly
if there was anything else he could help me with.
It was not easy for him to deal with my efforts
to force him to stop studying.
And after he got baptized,
I tried even harder.
But he never retaliated; he stayed calm and endured it.
In this period, I was trying to understand her reactions.
But it wasn’t easy for me.
Hearing her criticisms, those harsh replies, I thought sometimes:
‘I think I’ll just give up.
It makes no sense to go on like this.’
I said to the brother who was studying with me about this,
“I want to stop.”
And he encouraged me.
He said: “No, no, no, don’t stop.
“Don’t quit.
“Continue, continue.
Probably your wife will follow you.”
These conversations always encouraged me,
and when we finished our study,
I would see things from a different perspective.
I always loved my wife,
and I wanted her to be by my side.
During this period, he often told me how much he loved me
—many times, yes, very often.
And sometimes he would ask me if I loved him too.
There were times when I would answer him,
and there were times when I just smiled and said nothing.
And I even thought, ‘Hey, this guy really cares about me.’
I was impressed by his kindness.
I was very impressed.
Many times, I was musing: ‘Well, as a man, he could hit me.
He could be demanding, “You will sit down,”’ you know.
But no, he never did that.
He never raised his voice, never spoke a mean word
—never.
When she saw that I did not retaliate
—as in I would not reply harshly and I would not talk badly to her—
then eventually
she would calm down.
In his calm and mild way, he began inviting me to the meetings.
He kept on inviting me, and sometimes I was willing to accept.
Slowly, I started to attend the meetings.
I was happy.
I was very happy when she said she wanted to resume her study.
In August 2006,
I started studying the Bible again.
And in March 2007, I became an unbaptized publisher.
And in July 2007, I decided to get baptized.
I served in the Baptism Department,
and I had the privilege
to personally baptize my dear wife.
First Corinthians 13:4 says
that “love is patient and kind.”
Patience means,
first of all, being patient for months,
years, or maybe even decades.
Never give up.
Never consider someone as a lost cause.

title: 아렌시비아 가족: 삼 형제가 세 자매와 결혼해 고난의 때에 여호와를 신뢰하다

ko.text: 몇몇 형제 자매들과 해변에 놀러갈 계획을 했었습니다.
저희 자매들이 자랄 때 큰 영향을 주셨어요.
늘 가까이 살았기 때문에 자주 갔었죠.
부모님이 저희를 진리 안에서 양육하는 데 많은 도움을 주셨어요.
가족들과 한 시간 반 정도 떨어진 곳에 살았어요.
많이 힘들었는데 저희 세 자매는 정말 친하거든요.
여호와를 사랑하는 배우자를 찾아야 한다는 것을 알고 있었습니다.
배우자보다 여호와를 더 사랑하는 사람을 찾아야 한다고요.
전 여호와를 더 사랑하는 그런 자매를 찾았어요.
결혼 생활 내내 그 점을 느낍니다.
이게 바로 행복한 결혼 생활의 비결입니다.
결혼하고 가장 힘들었던 때는 순회 활동을 한 첫 해였어요.
두 달 뒤에는 외할아버지가, 반 년 뒤엔 어머니가 돌아가셨죠.
장모님이 사망한 뒤에는 제 어머니가 돌아가셨어요.
가족들을 세 명이나 잃고 큰 슬픔에 빠졌던 힘든 시기였죠.
순회 봉사를 더 이상 못할 것 같다는 생각이 여러 번 들었습니다.
여호와께서 결혼 생활에 늘 함께하시게 할 때
성경을 같이 읽고, 함께 봉사하고, 매일매일 함께하는 겁니다.
그렇게 할 때 여호와께서 실제로 결혼 생활에 함께하시게 되는 거죠.
저희는 함께 성경을 읽는 일이 아주 중요하다는 걸
저희 부부는 하나가 되는 걸 느낍니다.
저희는 결혼하기 전부터 각자 파이오니아를 하고 있었어요.
그래서 결혼하고도 함께 계속 파이오니아를 할 방법을 찾았습니다.
부부가 함께 여호와를 온전히 섬기고 싶었기 때문이죠.
우리는 도시에서 도시로 이동하면서 많은 시간을 함께 보냅니다.
묵상도 하고 이야기도 하면서 서로 가까워지죠.
여호와와 가까워질 뿐만 아니라 우리 사이도 더 친밀해집니다.
그리고 느낀 점들에 관해서 이야기를 많이 나누죠.
순회 활동을 해 오면서 경험해 보니까,
여호와께서 우리 결혼 생활에서 중요한 자리를 차지하시기 때문에
남편이나 저나 어떤 어려움을 겪든 흔들리지 않아요.
여호와께서 함께 계시니까 저희 두 사람의 관계도 튼튼해지죠.
여호와를 섬길 때만 그분이 함께 계시는 건 아닙니다.
그래서 저희는 다른 모든 일을 할 때도
봉사나 집회 시간 외에도 함께 시간을 보내는 걸 좋아하죠.
밖에 나가서 즐거운 시간을 자주 보내요.
저희는 어려움이 있을 때 함께 여호와께 기도합니다.
이런 이런 점을 도와 달라고 구체적으로 기도하죠.
같은 목표를 가지고 늘 함께 할 수 있어서 좋아요.
저희는 같은 목표로 함께 일하니까 같은 영적 일과를 보냅니다.
그래서 살면서 겪는 어려움들을 잘 견뎌낼 수 있었습니다.
여호와의 마련을 따르면 늘 좋은 결과가 있다는 걸 경험했어요.

en.text: It was summertime, and a group
of brothers and sisters made arrangements
during vacation time to go to the beach.
And so during that time,
heading to the beach is where I met her.
I had met her sisters, but I had not met her.
My grandparents and my aunt
were a very important part
in raising me and my sisters.
They learned the truth first, in Ecuador.
We always lived close by.
I always went to visit them.
And they helped my parents in guiding me into the truth.
The first three or four years of our marriage,
we were about an hour and a half away from our family.
That was really hard on me because I’m close to my sisters.
So it was kind of hard being so far— To me that was really far.
I knew early on that one of the most important things
that I needed in a mate is someone who loves Jehovah.
And they always say—
I remember my parents (and at the meetings) always said,
“Find someone who loves Jehovah more than they love you.”
And it’s easy to say that,
but then you find someone
and you realize that she loves Jehovah more than she loves you.
She has demonstrated it through our entire marriage.
When it comes to Jehovah, he’s first.
I think that is the key to a successful marriage.
I think the biggest challenge we went through in our marriage
was our first year in the circuit work.
It was hard enough moving 3,000 miles away from everyone
and starting a new type of life.
Two months later, my grandfather dies;
six months right after that, my mother dies.
So after her mom died, my mom passed away.
It was one right after the other.
That was a difficult time for us
—all the pain and suffering
from losing our moms and loved ones.
Many times we felt that we could not continue.
It was overwhelming.
The period of time was eight months
and ten days between the death of Mimi’s mom and my mom.
The threefold cord is a routine in which Jehovah is included
in the marriage
—from reading the Bible together,
to going in the ministry together,
to doing everyday things together.
And as you do this, Jehovah is present in your marriage.
We always think that it’s our Bible reading.
Actually, we don’t think—we realize
that our Bible reading is very important for us.
We pick a book; we start reading it, and we know
that is what keeps us together.
We were both already pioneering before we got married.
And when we got married,
we just figured out a way to continue pioneering together
to make sure to start our spiritual careers together.
So we have to always depend on Jehovah,
which is the best Person to always depend on.
We spent a lot of time by ourselves,
driving from city to city and from state to state.
We had plenty of time to reflect, to talk,
and to draw close to each other
—to not only rely on Jehovah but also to be closer between us
and to spend more time
talking about the visits,
talking about the friends, and talking about how we feel.
I think that at the end it was the toughest assignment,
but it was the most rewarding
of all the assignments we had had
in all these years in the traveling work.
Because it’s the three of us and Jehovah’s an equal part of our marriage,
it doesn’t matter what we go through
—whether it’s Peter or I that’s having a little bit of a struggle—
because Jehovah is there.
He’s going to keep us united and strong.
And also, it’s not just in the things we do while we worship.
Yes, we worship together,
but it’s also all the other things that we do Jehovah’s way.
We’re best friends, and we enjoy spending time together
outside of service and the meetings.
We like doing fun things outside. We like the outdoors.
When we’re facing a difficult challenge, we will go to Jehovah in prayer together
and specifically pray, “Jehovah, help us with this challenge.”
Our assignments have helped us
to always be with each other because we have the same goals in mind.
We’re working together
for the same purpose.
So the same schedule —spiritual schedule—
has really helped us to go through these challenging periods in our life.
Knowing that Jehovah is our Creator, the Sovereign Being
—he’s the one who should tell us what to do.
And there is an arrangement, and when you follow his arrangement,
there’s happiness; there’s success.
We’re in an imperfect world,
but his arrangement works, and we have felt it.
